<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARENA LICENSE AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This ARENA LICENSE AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<B>Agreement</B>&#8221;) is made as of April&nbsp;15, 2020 (the &#8220;<B>Effective
Date</B>&#8221;) between MSG Arena, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (&#8220;<B>Licensor</B>&#8221;), and New York Rangers, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;<B>Rangers</B>&#8221;). Licensor and the Rangers are each
referred to individually as a &#8220;<B>Party</B>&#8221; and collectively as the &#8220;<B>Parties</B>.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>R<SMALL>ECITALS</SMALL> </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A.&#8195;Licensor owns and operates the arena commonly known as Madison Square Garden, which is located at 4 Pennsylvania Plaza, New York,
New York 10001 that contains approximately 17,000<B> </B>seats for hockey games, and is suitable for the exhibition of ice hockey games and for other purposes (the &#8220;<B>Arena</B>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">B.&#8195;New York Rangers, LLC owns and operates the professional hockey team known as the New York Rangers (the &#8220;<B>Team</B>&#8221;)
in the National Hockey League (the &#8220;<B>NHL</B>&#8221; or the &#8220;<B>League</B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">C.&#8195;Licensor wishes to grant the
Rangers, on behalf of the Team, certain rights to use specified parts of the Arena at specified times, and the Rangers desire to so use the Arena at such times, upon the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Now, therefore, in consideration of the foregoing, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are
hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE I </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DEFINITIONS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;ADA Consent Decree&#8221;</B> means the Consent Decree entered November&nbsp;5, 2007 in the lawsuit entitled <U>United States of
America vs. Madison Square Garden, L.P., et al.</U>, 07 Civ. 9704 (RJH), in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Advertising&#8221;</B> means, collectively, all advertising, sponsorship and promotional activity, signage, messages and displays of
every kind and nature at or regarding the Arena, whether audio or visual and whether now existing or developed in the future, including the following: (i)&nbsp;the right to name the Arena or any portion thereof, including identifying such name on
the Arena concourses, the entrances to the Arena, premium seating areas or any other areas at the Arena; (ii)&nbsp;permanent, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-permanent</FONT> and transitory signage or advertising displayed on permanent (e.g.,
fixed panel) or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-permanent</FONT> (e.g., rotating) advertising panels or on the interior or exterior of the Arena (including Arena marquee boards and other exterior signage); (iii) advertising appearing on
fixtures or equipment (such as scoreboard advertising and canopy advertising); (iv) audio or video public address advertising and message board advertising; (v)&nbsp;electronic insertion, fascia boards, liquid electronic displays, ribbon boards and
other forms of electronic signage (&#8220;<B>LED Signage</B>&#8221;); (vi) print and display advertising, including advertising on or in game programs, </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
schedules, tickets and yearbooks; (vii)&nbsp;promotional events or activities sponsored by corporate partners; (viii)&nbsp;the exhibition and promotion of products and services at the Arena
(e.g., kiosks and special areas in the concourse); (ix) advertising worn or carried by concessionaire personnel or other personnel engaged in the operation of any Arena event; (x)&nbsp;advertising affixed to or included with cups, napkins, utensils,
plates or other similar items used to consume Concessions at the Arena (&#8220;<B>Concession Items</B>&#8221;); (xi) advertising at concession areas; and (xii)&nbsp;promotional or premium item give-aways. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Affiliate&#8221; </B>means, with respect to any specified Person, any other Person directly or indirectly controlling or controlled
by, or under direct or indirect common control with, such specified Person, or which is a director, officer, employee, or partner (limited or general) of such specified Person, but with respect to either Party specifically excluding the other Party
and the other Party&#8217;s publicly owned parent and such parent entity&#8217;s direct and indirect subsidiaries. For the purpose of this definition, &#8220;control&#8221;, when used with respect to any specified Person, means the power to direct
or cause, directly or indirectly, the direction of the management and policies of such Person whether through the voting of securities, by contract or otherwise. The terms &#8220;controlling&#8221; and &#8220;controlled&#8221; have meanings
correlative to the foregoing. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Agreement</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Arena</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Recital A. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Arena Agency Agreements</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7.02(b)</U>. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Casualty</B>&#8221; shall mean any damage, destruction or other property casualty of any kind or nature, ordinary or extraordinary,
foreseen or unforeseen resulting from any cause, including any Force Majeure event. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Catering Services</B>&#8221; and

<U>Schedule 4.01</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Concessions</B>&#8221; means F&amp;B Concessions, Team Merchandise sold or provided at the Arena, and <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Condemnation</B>&#8221; means a taking by eminent domain, condemnation
or appropriation by any governmental authority or other Person with the power of eminent domain for any public or private use or purpose. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Auditing</FONT> Party</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;20.17</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise</B>&#8221; means all
programs, other publications, and merchandise other than Team Merchandise. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Other Arena Event</B>&#8221; has the meaning set
forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.04(c)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Other Rangers Event</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.04(b)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Party</B>&#8221; or &#8220;<B>Parties</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the
preamble. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Person</B>&#8221; means any individual, corporation, company, voluntary association, partnership, incorporated
organization, trust, limited liability company, or any other entity or organization. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Playoff Home Games</B>&#8221; means games
played after the end of the League&#8217;s regular season as part of its championship tournament, for which the Team must qualify based on its regular season record, where the Team (and not the opposing team) has the right to designate the location
of such game or which is considered one of the Team&#8217;s home games by the League for purposes of League Rules or scheduling. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Property Tax Exemption</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;16.01</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Property Tax Exemption Agreement</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;16.01</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers Default</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;17.01</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers Event&#8221; </B>means<B> </B>Home Games and Other Rangers Events. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers Misuse</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.07</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers&#8217; Personnel and Guests</B>&#8221; means the personnel, guests and invitees of the Rangers (including holders of tickets
of admission to the Arena, holders of press and media credentials, and visiting team personnel). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rangers&#8217; Promotional
Use</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;10.01(d)</U>. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Representatives</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in

<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7.01</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Standard</B>&#8221; means, with respect to the applicable requirement, obligation or
matter, (a)&nbsp;in compliance with applicable law, (b)&nbsp;in compliance with League Rules and (c)&nbsp;at a first-class level equal to or better than that at which NHL arenas in major U.S. markets are then operated, maintained and improved for
NHL games (in the case of improvements, taking into reasonable consideration the age and location of the Arena and its existing structural limitations), and in no event less than the highest standard of quality and manner in which the Arena
(i)&nbsp;was operated, maintained and improved historically (post 2011 - 2013 transformation) with respect to Home Games and (ii)&nbsp;will be operated, maintained and improved for Other Arena Events. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8220;Suite 200&#8221;</B> has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.03(h)</U>. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Team Areas</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Schedule 4.01</U>. </P>

STYLE="white-space:nowrap">All-Star</FONT> Game, the Stanley Cup Playoffs, the NHL Winter Classic), or the logo(s) of any of the foregoing. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Team Merchandise Allocation</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.02(d)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Term</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.01</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>The Loft</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.03(d)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Ticket</B>&#8221; or &#8220;<B>Tickets</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.01</U>. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Ticket Agent Agreement</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.06(a)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Untenantable Condition</B>&#8221; means a condition of the Arena that occurs on account of a Casualty or Condemnation and, as a
result of which League Rules or applicable law prohibit the playing of Home Games at the Arena or would entail denial of access to or loss of a material portion of (i)&nbsp;the general seating areas of the Arena or (ii)&nbsp;revenues of the Rangers
derived from the Arena. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">7 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>VIP Club Services</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.03</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>VIP Clubs</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.03</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Work Stoppage</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;15.01</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE II </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TERM </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;2.01&#8195;<U>Term; Commencement Date</U></B>. The term of this Agreement shall commence on April&nbsp;17, 2020 (the
&#8220;<B>Commencement Date</B>&#8221;) and, unless earlier terminated in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, shall end on June&nbsp;30, 2055 (the &#8220;<B>Term</B>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE III </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>LICENSE FEE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;3.01&#8195;<U>License Fee</U></B>. The Rangers shall pay to Licensor a license fee, without any right of offset, reduction or
abatement (except as expressly provided in this Agreement), as follows: (a)&nbsp;for the Initial Contract Year, a prorated amount equal to $16,200,000 divided by forty-four (44), multiplied by the number of Exhibition and Regular Season Home games
scheduled to be played in the Arena in the Initial Contract Year; (b)&nbsp;for the First Full Contract Year, $16,686,000; and (c)&nbsp;for each subsequent Contract Year, 103% of the license fee for the immediately preceding Contract Year (the
&#8220;<B>License Fee</B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;3.02&#8195;<U>Payment of License Fee</U></B>. For each Contract Year, the Rangers
shall pay the License Fee in twelve (12)&nbsp;equal installments on the first business day of each month during the Contract Year, except that the License Fee for the Initial Contract Year shall be paid in equal monthly installments on the first
business day of the month following the Commencement Date and the first business day of each remaining month in the Initial Contract Year. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE IV </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>USE
OF ARENA </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.01&#8195;<U>Arena </U><U>Areas</U></B>. The Arena includes the areas identified on <U>Schedule 4.01</U>
attached hereto. The Parties shall regularly coordinate and discuss with one another and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the precise locations, square footage,
appearance and amenities of the Common Areas and Team Areas set forth therein shall be subject to change from time to time during the Term in accordance with Section&nbsp;4.05. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">8 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.02&#8195;<U>Rangers Use</U></B>. Licensor hereby grants to the Rangers and
the Rangers&#8217; Personnel and Guests, and the Rangers hereby accept from Licensor, for itself and the Rangers&#8217; Personnel and Guests, a license to use the Arena as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Common Areas and Team Areas</U>. Subject to League Rules, on each Home Date, beginning at approximately 10:00 a.m., until two
(2)&nbsp;hours after the completion of such Home Game, the Rangers shall have the exclusive right and license to use the Common Areas and the Team Areas for the purpose of playing of Home Games and conducting related activities, and the presentation
thereof by any and all means, live and over radio and television and all other means of communication now existing and hereafter developed, and such other uses expressly permitted in this Agreement or as may be agreed to by the Parties.
Notwithstanding the foregoing start time, Licensor may schedule Other Arena Events (as defined below) on Home Dates (each, a &#8220;<B>Shared Date</B>&#8221;) in accordance with Section&nbsp;4.04(c); provided that in no event shall the Rangers have
exclusive access to the Common Areas and Team Areas any later than three (3)&nbsp;hours prior to the start of any Home Game. Licensor shall reimburse the Rangers for any costs incurred by the Rangers solely as a result of a Home Game occurring on a
Shared Date (e.g., visiting team relocating a morning skate). In addition, the Rangers shall have reasonable access, on a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive</FONT> basis, to the Common Areas and the Team Areas for purposes related to the
business or hockey operations of the Rangers at reasonable times on days that are not Home Dates and during periods on Home Dates other than those specified above (but in no case during ticketed Other Arena Events (as defined in Section&nbsp;4.04(c)
below)), provided the Rangers&#8217; use of the Common Areas may not unreasonably interfere with any use by Licensor or authorized use by its other licensees (including the Knicks). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Access</U>. All rights and licenses set forth in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.02</U> include in favor of the Rangers and
the Rangers Personnel and Guests (including holders of tickets of admission to the Arena, holders of press and media credentials, and visiting team personnel), subject to the Arena&#8217;s safety and security protocols as provided in
Section&nbsp;4.06(b), (i) rights and licenses of entry, ingress and egress over and across all applicable portions of the Arena, and (ii)&nbsp;the right and license to bring into the Arena (and to permit the Rangers Personnel and Guests into the
Arena), and retain ownership and control of, items of personal property and equipment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Grant of License</U>. This Agreement
is intended to, and shall be construed as, a grant of a license by Licensor to the Rangers and the Rangers Personnel and Guests, and shall not operate to vest in the Rangers any ownership or leasehold interest, or other real estate interest, in the
Arena or the property of Licensor, whether real or personal, tangible or intangible, or any use or possessory rights other than those rights expressly granted by the license hereunder (and then subject to and in accordance with all of the provisions
of this Agreement). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.03&#8195;<U>Licensor</U><U>&#8217;</U><U>s </U><U>Right of Entry</U></B>. Notwithstanding the
provisions of Section&nbsp;4.02, but subject to League Rules, Licensor and its agents and representatives shall have the right to enter into and upon any and all parts of the Arena, including the Team Areas and the Common Areas, as necessary for the
purpose of carrying out its obligations under this Agreement, to operate the Arena, to perform necessary safety, security and maintenance activities and for other purposes that do not unreasonably interfere with the Rangers&#8217; rights hereunder.
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">9 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.04&#8195;<U>Scheduling</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Team Games</U>. The scheduling procedure for Home Games shall continue in a manner consistent with past practice, subject to, and
at all times in accordance with, League Rules. It is understood between the Parties that Licensor is entering into a simultaneous license with New York Knicks, LLC (the &#8220;<B>Knicks</B>&#8221;), on behalf of the professional basketball team
known as the New York Knicks, to host basketball games (&#8220;<B>Knicks Games</B>&#8221;) in the Arena. The Parties will continue to cooperate with each other in good faith recognizing that Licensor has obligations to the Knicks. Consistent with
past practice, Licensor will jointly coordinate with the League and the National Basketball Association in scheduling Home Games and Knicks Games. In addition, each Party shall (i)&nbsp;use reasonable efforts to avoid material business impacts on
the other Party where such Party has the ability to do so and (ii)&nbsp;reasonably cooperate and honor requests for changes to previously scheduled or held dates. For the avoidance of doubt, in the event of any conflict between any of the foregoing
and League Rules, League Rules shall control and govern. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Other Rangers Events and Usage. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)&#8195;Subject to the terms of this subsection, the Rangers shall be entitled to license the Arena without payment of an
incremental license fee on up to two (2)&nbsp;occasions per Contract Year, to present certain Team-related events other than Home Games (e.g., open practices, ticket sales events, season subscriber events and similar functions as mutually agreed)
(each, an &#8220;<B>Other Rangers Event</B>&#8221;). Dates for Other Rangers Events may be reserved no earlier than forty-five (45)&nbsp;days in advance of the proposed event and such reservations shall be subject to any dates previously booked by
Licensor for Other Arena Events. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii)&#8195;The Rangers may use such Team Areas and Common Areas, and Licensor shall
provide such Licensor Services (for which <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Game-Day</FONT> Services the Rangers shall pay or reimburse Licensor as provided herein), as are reasonably necessary or requested by the Rangers for such Other Rangers
Events. Other Rangers Events shall be subject to other terms and conditions to be negotiated by the Parties. Unless the Parties agree otherwise with respect to a particular event, all terms of this Agreement applicable to Home Games will apply to
Other Rangers Events. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii)&#8195;At the Rangers&#8217; request, Licensor may, in its discretion, license the Arena and/or
other Licensor-owned venues (e.g., Beacon Theater, Radio City, Tao) to the Rangers to the extent available and without payment of an incremental license fee (the Rangers shall pay any expenses). Such events may be in addition to Other Rangers
Events. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Other Arena Events</U>. Subject to Section&nbsp;4.04(a), Licensor shall be entitled to schedule Knicks Games, other
sporting events, concerts, and any other types of events in the Arena (each, an &#8220;<B>Other Arena Event</B>&#8221;), including, for the avoidance of doubt, on the same day as a Home Game; provided that: (i)&nbsp;no Other Arena Event shall
relieve Licensor of its obligations hereunder, including to deliver the Common Areas and Team Areas to the Rangers in the condition required by ARTICLE IX by or before the times required in Section&nbsp;4.02(a), and (ii)&nbsp;no Other Arena Event
shall be scheduled if it could reasonably be expected to materially interfere with the presentation, use or operation of the Arena for any previously scheduled Rangers Events (or the revenues derived by the Rangers therefrom). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">10 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.05&#8195;<U>Alterations</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Rangers Alterations</U>. During the Term, the Rangers may request that Licensor make alterations to the Team Areas and/or Common
Areas. Licensor shall make those alterations to the extent necessary to comply with its obligations under this Agreement, at Licensor&#8217;s sole cost and expense. To the extent those alterations are not necessary for Licensor to comply with its
obligations under this Agreement, those alterations shall be subject to the approval of Licensor, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, and shall be made at the Rangers&#8217; sole cost and expense (subject to the
Rangers&#8217; approval of Licensor&#8217;s plans and costs); it being understood that Licensor may deny its approval if it reasonably determines that such alterations would materially adversely impact Licensor or any third party who regularly uses
the space (e.g., the Knicks). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Licensor Alterations</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Licensor shall have the right to make alterations or other changes to the Arena, in its sole discretion and at
its sole cost and expense; provided that Licensor shall be required to obtain the prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed) of the Rangers to the extent that any such alterations or changes could reasonably be
expected to impact the Rangers&#8217; rights or obligations hereunder, or the presentation, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">set-up,</FONT> use or operation of the Arena for any Rangers Event. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Without limiting ARTICLE IX, Licensor shall be responsible for making alterations, upgrades, modifications and
improvements to the Arena (and the components thereof) at Licensor&#8217;s sole cost and expense (subject to Section&nbsp;4.05(c)), as may be required from time to time in order to maintain the Arena in accordance with the Standard.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Alterations intended to generate additional premium seating revenues for both Licensor and the Rangers shall be
governed by the terms of Section&nbsp;5.04. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Alterations Pursuant to League Rules</U>. Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, any alterations, upgrades, modifications or improvements to the Arena that are made solely to comply with any new or amended League Rules that are enacted after the Commencement Date shall be
made at the Rangers&#8217; sole expense. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Parties shall cooperate in good faith to agree on the plans and specifications for
alterations made under Sections 4.05(a) &#8211; (c) and the time period during which such alterations are expected to be made. All such alterations shall (i)&nbsp;be made by Licensor or its contractors, (ii)&nbsp;comply with all applicable laws,
ordinances, orders, regulations and League Rules, (iii)&nbsp;be completed in a good and workmanlike manner, using new materials or their equivalent, without unreasonable delay, (iv)&nbsp;not interfere with gameplay in accordance with League Rules
and (v)&nbsp;not materially interfere with the presentation, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">set-up,</FONT> use or operation of the Arena for any Rangers Event (or the revenues derived by the Rangers therefrom), without the Rangers&#8217; prior
written approval. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.06&#8195;<U>Manner of the Rangers</U><U>&#8217;</U><U> Use</U></B><B>.</B>
At all times during the Term: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The Rangers shall use the Arena in accordance with all League Rules and applicable laws,
ordinances, and regulations. Licensor shall operate the Arena in accordance with all League Rules, applicable laws, ordinances, and regulations. Without limiting the foregoing, each party shall be responsible, with respect to its functions, rights
and obligations under this Agreement, for compliance with the ADA Consent Decree as if it is a party thereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;The Rangers and
their guests, invitees, patrons, and designees shall be subject to any reasonable and nondiscriminatory rules and regulations and security procedures that Licensor imposes on the use of the Arena, so long as the same (i)&nbsp;are not inconsistent
with the other provisions of this Agreement (including Licensor&#8217;s requirement to maintain and operate the Arena in accordance with the Standard) or League Rules, and (ii)&nbsp;are uniformly applied to all other occupants and users of the Arena
except to the extent necessitated by differing particular event types. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Each Party shall, at any time and from time to time,
upon not less than ten (10)&nbsp;days prior written request from the other Party, execute, acknowledge and deliver to the requesting Party, in a form reasonably satisfactory to the requesting Party and, if applicable, its existing or prospective
direct or indirect lender or purchaser, a written estoppel statement certifying, (i)&nbsp;that this Agreement is unmodified and in full force and effect (or, if there have been modifications, that the same is in full force and effect as modified and
stating the modifications), (ii) if true (or, if not entirely true, listing any exceptions), that the requesting Party is not in default hereunder, (iii)&nbsp;the date to which the License Fee and other charges have been paid in advance, if any, and
(iv)&nbsp;such other accurate certifications as may reasonably be required by the requesting Party or its existing or prospective direct or indirect lender or purchaser, and agreeing to give copies to the requesting Party&#8217;s existing or
prospective direct or indirect lender or purchaser of all material notices by the stating Party to the requesting Party, and agreeing to afford the requesting Party&#8217;s existing or prospective direct or indirect lender or purchaser an
opportunity to cure any default of the stating Party within the applicable cure period afforded to the requesting Party hereunder. It is intended that any such statement delivered pursuant to this subsection may be relied upon by any prospective
direct or indirect lender to or purchaser of the Rangers or of the Arena and their respective successors and assigns. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.07&#8195;<U>Rangers Misuse</U></B>. The Rangers shall promptly reimburse Licensor for costs of cleaning, repairs or
replacements, net of insurance proceeds received under Article XIV, necessitated by (a)&nbsp;uses by the Rangers not permitted under this Agreement, or (b)&nbsp;grossly negligent, reckless or willful acts of the Rangers or visiting NHL teams for
Rangers Events that cause such damage (collectively, <B>&#8220;Rangers Misuse&#8221;</B>). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">12 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;4.08&#8195; <U>Surrender</U></B>. Upon the expiration of the Term or earlier
termination of this Agreement, the Rangers shall promptly vacate the Arena under the direction of and in the manner reasonably approved by Licensor, and shall surrender all of its keys, access cards, and other credentials and access items for the
Arena to Licensor, and shall inform Licensor of all combinations on all of its locks, safes, and vaults, if any, in the Arena. Without limiting the foregoing, the Rangers shall not remove any alterations, improvements, or other property (other than
personal property not affixed or attached to the Arena or any elements thereof) from the Arena unless permitted to do so by Licensor, and the Rangers shall promptly reimburse Licensor for the cost of repairing any damage caused by such removal. Any
personal property of the Rangers which remains in the Arena after the expiration of the Term or earlier termination of this Agreement may, at the option of Licensor, be deemed to have been abandoned, and, in Licensor&#8217;s sole discretion,
(a)&nbsp;may be retained by Licensor as its property, (b)&nbsp;shall be disposed of by the Rangers at the request of Licensor, or (c)&nbsp;may be disposed of by Licensor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE V </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TICKETS, SUITES AND CLUBS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.01&#8195;<U>Prices</U></B>. As between Licensor and the Rangers, (a)&nbsp;the Rangers shall have sole discretion to control
the manifest and determine the prices and fees (subject to Section&nbsp;5.06(a)) for all tickets and other indicia authorizing admission (each a &#8220;<B>Ticket</B>&#8221;) for<B> </B>general admission seating, standing room and other general
admission spectator positions in the Arena for all Rangers Events, and (b)&nbsp;except as provided below, Licensor shall have sole discretion to control the manifest and determine the license fees to be paid for the Suites, The Loft, the Madison
Club and similar premium spaces developed in accordance with Section&nbsp;5.03 and Section&nbsp;5.04 during the Term. There shall be no limit on the number of complimentary Tickets the Rangers may issue. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.02&#8195;<U>Ticket Revenues</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Ticket Sales</U>. The Rangers shall have the exclusive right to sell and resell all Tickets and retain all revenues from all
Ticket sales and resales, including the Facility Ticket Fee (as defined in Section&nbsp;5.02(c)), the Rangers&#8217; share of any Convenience Fee (as defined in Section&nbsp;5.06(a)), and any personal seat licenses the Rangers may elect to sell,
provided, that the Rangers right to sell personal seat licenses shall be limited to Rangers Events only (and no Other Arena Events) and provided further, that any &#8220;form&#8221; agreement for the sale or licensing of personal seat licenses shall
be subject to Licensor&#8217;s prior approval, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, and the Rangers shall not make any material alterations to such form agreement that adversely impact Licensor without Licensor&#8217;s prior
written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Loaded-Value Tickets</U>. To the extent that the
Rangers offer a ticket product with which the ticketholder is entitled to <I>gratis</I> Concessions in addition to seating to a Home Game, Licensor shall provide such Concessions and the Rangers shall remit to Licensor the actual retail value of any
Concessions redeemed by each such ticketholder, which revenue will be included in Team Merchandise revenue (to the extent that the sale/redemption relates to Team Merchandise) or F&amp;B Concessions Gross Receipts, as applicable. To the extent that
the sale/redemption relates </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">13 </P>

</DIV></Center>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise, Licensor shall retain all such redeemed
amounts. For purposes of clarity, any revenue associated with loaded-value tickets that is not redeemed for Concessions shall remain the property of the Rangers. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Facility Ticket Fee</U>. The Rangers shall charge to all primary Home Game Ticket purchasers a
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">per-Ticket</FONT> facility fee (the &#8220;<B>Facility Ticket Fee</B>&#8221;), in an amount determined from time to time by Licensor following consultation with the Rangers. The Facility Ticket Fee will generally be
applied consistently to tickets for Other Arena Events and Home Games, provided that (a)&nbsp;the Rangers may charge a higher or lower Facility Ticket Fee for Home Games with Licensor&#8217;s approval (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or
delayed), and (b)&nbsp;the Rangers shall have the option, without Licensor&#8217;s approval, not to charge a Facility Ticket Fee to season ticketholders (including holders of full and partial season packages), group ticketholders, suite pass holders
or with respect to any complimentary tickets. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;5.03</B>&#8195;<B><U>Suites; </U></B><B><U>Madison Club; The
Loft</U></B>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Suites</U>. Subject to other provisions of this Section&nbsp;5.03, Licensor shall have the exclusive right to
license Suites to third parties for all or a portion of Rangers Events and Other Arena Events and collect license fees for the privilege of using the Suites and related amenities. Licensor shall be responsible for all costs of licensing, operating,
servicing and maintaining the Suites in accordance with the Standard. Revenues generated from the licensing of Suites shall be allocated as set forth in Section&nbsp;5.03(b). All of the terms and conditions of such licenses and appurtenant Arena
admission tickets and other rights and obligations related to the occupancy of Suites shall be governed by separate agreements (each, a &#8220;Suite Agreement&#8221;) entered into between Licensor and the licensees of Suites. Licensor&#8217;s
&#8220;form&#8221; Suite Agreements shall be subject to the prior written approval of the Rangers (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), and Licensor shall not make any material alterations to the form Suite Agreements or any
executed Suite Agreement that adversely impact the Rangers without the Rangers&#8217; prior written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Suites Revenue. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

of $100,000, Rangers receive as its share of the license fee $325,000 (($1,100,000 -$100,000) x 32.5%). In the event of a No Fault Occurrence, the Rangers Suites Revenue Share shall be increased to 40.5%. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

non-</P></TD></TR></TABLE>

Team events, Licensor shall ensure that such contracted catering credits or Included F&amp;B Packages have the same terms and conditions, at the Suite licensee&#8217;s discretion, at both Team

and maintained on an arms-length basis (it being acknowledged that the fee payable by the TAO Group to Licensor for the twelve-month period ended June&nbsp;30, 2019 is arms-length for purposes of this Section&nbsp;5.03(c)). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;The Madison Club and The Loft. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Licensor shall be responsible for selling and servicing Madison Club and Loft memberships and operating,
maintaining and servicing the Madison Club and The Loft in accordance with the Standard. The Rangers shall receive 32.5% of all revenues collected or received by Licensor from the sale of memberships to the Madison Club and The Loft, net of taxes
and credit card fees (the &#8220;<B>Rangers Hospitality Share</B>&#8221;). The Rangers shall reimburse Licensor for (a)&nbsp;the direct cost of providing complimentary food and beverage, and (b)&nbsp;the cost of other direct event variable labor
(e.g., concierge, coat check, etc.), other than labor related to Concessions that are sold, attributable to the Madison Club and The Loft for Home Games, in each case under (a)&nbsp;and (b), which costs shall be consistent for all events and on a
basis as determined in consultation with the Rangers. Schedule 5.03(d) sets forth the staffing levels for the Madison Club and The Loft as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Season (which takes into account the services provided
for the Madison Club and The Loft as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Season). For all Home Games and similar (based on factors including expected attendance) Other Arena Events, Licensor shall maintain substantially similar
levels of service and staffing (as set forth on Schedule 5.03(d)), provided that the Parties </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

Arena Events, Licensor will also operate a box office (including will call support) during reasonable business hours, and for all Rangers Events commencing at the earlier of (i)&nbsp;noon and (ii)&nbsp;the opening of the Arena doors for the

office operations. </P>

and all creative content to be included on such Tickets printed by Licensor at the Rangers&#8217; request. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Group Ticket

packages. The Rangers shall sell, invoice and collect all revenues from such Ticket packages, in its sole discretion. The Rangers shall be responsible for all credit card fees and other similar charges in connection with the sale of such Tickets.
The Rangers shall develop any and all creative content to be included on such Tickets printed by Licensor at the Rangers&#8217; request. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">In-Arena</FONT> Ticket Sales</U>. During Rangers Events, the Rangers shall be permitted to have
tables and kiosks on the concourse for the sole purpose of selling season (including partial) ticket and group ticket packages for the Rangers and its Affiliates. The placement of such tables and kiosks shall be reasonably determined by Licensor
consistent with past practice. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;5.06</B>&#8195;<B><U>Ticket Agent</U></B>.<U> </U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Ticket Agent Agreements</U>. The Rangers shall be required to utilize and comply with the current primary and secondary ticket
provider agreement(s) with Licensor&#8217;s ticket agent (the &#8220;<B>Ticket Agent</B>&#8221;), and any amendment, modification or replacement of the same in accordance with Section&nbsp;5.06(b), (the &#8220;<B>Ticket Agent Agreements</B>&#8221;)
for applicable Ticket transactions for Home Games and any Other Rangers Events to which tickets are sold. It is understood that a portion of any upfront or annual fees received by Licensor from the Ticket Agent during the Term shall be allocated to
the Rangers on a pro rata basis on equitable terms (e.g., based on projected ticket sales for the businesses covered by the Ticket Agent Agreements). It is further understood that the Rangers may establish in its discretion, following consultation
with Licensor, the level of &#8220;convenience fees&#8221; or other fees to be imposed on Tickets for Rangers Events pursuant to the Ticket Agent Agreements (&#8220;<B>Convenience Fees</B>&#8221;) and to retain as Rangers Ticket revenue hereunder
all amounts collected in connection therewith subject to the provisions of the Ticket Agent Agreements that provide for a portion of such fees to be paid to the Ticket Agent. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Amended or Replacement Ticket Agent Agreements</U>. Licensor shall have the right to negotiate and administer any amendments to
the current Ticket Agent Agreements or any replacement ticket provider agreement with a third party, provided that, (i)&nbsp;any portion of such amendment or replacement agreement that relates to the Rangers or Rangers Events or (ii)&nbsp;any
renewal or extension of the current Ticket Agent Agreements or any replacement ticket provider </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">20 </P>

agreement, in each case, shall be subject to the prior written approval of the Rangers. If the Rangers do not grant such approval, the Rangers may enter into its own ticket provider agreement(s),
provided that the Rangers or such other ticket provider shall pay all costs needed to implement such other ticketing systems at the Arena. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Access to Systems and Data</U>. Licensor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to (i)&nbsp;include in its Ticket Agent
Agreements an obligation to provide the Rangers with substantially similar access to relevant information about the Rangers&#8217; customers and sales activity that resides in the Ticket Agent&#8217;s database and other system components as are
provided under Licensor&#8217;s current agreement with Ticketmaster, (ii)&nbsp;enforce such obligation on behalf of the Rangers at the Rangers&#8217; expense and (iii)&nbsp;enforce any other terms of any Ticket Agent Agreements that affect the
Rangers at the Rangers&#8217; expense; it being understood that, with respect to any agreements where the Rangers are an express party or a third party beneficiary, Licensor shall have no obligations under clauses (ii)&nbsp;or (iii), above. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.07&#8195;<U>Ticket Settlement Process</U></B>. Licensor shall, or shall cause Ticket Agent to, remit to the Rangers all
amounts collected in connection with the sale of Tickets on a weekly basis, together with an itemized statement indicating the number and price of each Ticket sold and related fees collected. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.08&#8195;<U>Access to Tickets</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Complimentary Tickets for Home Games</U>. Licensor shall be afforded access to a pool of complimentary tickets for Home Games
throughout the Term, on the following terms: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Chairman and CEO of The Madison Square Garden Company and (y)&nbsp;ten (10) additional lower-bowl tickets located in the center 100s sections or lower, or other sections as the Parties may otherwise agree, it being understood that the Parties shall
regularly coordinate and discuss with one another and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment to the number and location of the &#8220;additional&#8221; complimentary tickets described in clause (y). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
