<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Complimentary tickets may be used by Licensor for its and its Affiliates&#8217; employees or other business
purposes but may not be resold. If such complimentary tickets will not be used, such tickets may be sold by the Rangers and the Rangers may retain all revenue therefrom. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Pools of Tickets for Purchase</U>. The Rangers shall be afforded access to purchase tickets from a pool of tickets for Other
Arena Events, and Licensor shall be afforded access to purchase tickets from a pool of tickets for Home Games, in each case subject to availability. Such tickets may be used by the Rangers or Licensor (as applicable) for their Affiliates, employees
or other business purposes but may not be resold. Each ticket pool shall also be subject to such other procedures, restraints and limitations as may be determined by the Party offering access. In both cases, the Parties shall regularly coordinate
and discuss with one another and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment to the number and locations of the tickets in the pool. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">21 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.10&#8195;<U>Credentials and Passes</U></B>. The Rangers may issue a
reasonable number of passes to photo, press and media, staff, visiting teams, performers (e.g., dance teams and intermission performers), League personnel and any other Person, pursuant to the directions of the Rangers from time to time, permitting
such selected persons free access to the Arena for Rangers Events and to specified areas of the Arena normally closed to the public; provided, however, that any such issuance is in accordance with League Rules, including, without limitation, the
then-prevailing NHL Recommendations for Arena Security and Licensor&#8217;s Arena safety and security protocols. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;5.11&#8195;<U>Admission to Arena</U></B>. Licensor shall not grant any spectator admission to the Arena for any Rangers Event
unless such spectator has acquired and displays a Ticket or other indicia of admission (e.g., a press or related pass) to such Rangers Event issued by Licensor or the Rangers (or, if applicable, the League) in accordance with this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE VI </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CONCESSIONS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.01&#8195;<U>F&amp;B Concessions</U><U> and Catering</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Licensor shall have the exclusive right and obligation to operate and manage the sale of F&amp;B Concessions and Catering Services
during all Rangers Events in a manner reasonably calculated to maximize profits but subject to providing a positive customer experience in accordance with the Standard and subject to Schedule 6.01. The Rangers shall receive 50% of the Net Profits
(as defined in Schedule 6.01) from the sale of F&amp;B Concessions and Catering Services attributable to Rangers Events (the &#8220;<B>Rangers F&amp;B Concessions and Catering Share</B>&#8221;). To the extent Licensor directly manages and conducts
the sale of such F&amp;B Concessions and Catering Services, such sales shall be provided in accordance with Schedule 6.01. In the event of a No Fault Occurrence, the Rangers F&amp;B Concessions and Catering Share shall be increased to 58%. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;In the event Licensor retains a third party to provide F&amp;B Concessions and/or Catering Services or enters into a lease, license
or operating agreement for food and beverage space, in each case, in accordance with Section&nbsp;6.04 the Rangers shall receive 50% of all amounts received by Licensor (including any annual payments, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">up-front</FONT>
payments, advances, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">back-end</FONT> payments, earn-outs, guarantees, allowances, rebates, refunds, discounts or any other payments or revenues retained by Licensor or its Affiliate) attributable to Rangers Events
from any such arrangement or agreement (the &#8220;<B>Third Party F&amp;B Share</B>&#8221;); provided that, with respect to amounts received that cannot be specifically traced to a Rangers Event as opposed to an Other Arena Event, Licensor shall
reasonably and fairly estimate the portion of the total amount that is attributable to Rangers Events (which estimate shall be subject to the review and approval of the Rangers, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed) and shall
remit to the Rangers the Third Party F&amp;B Share of the portion of such amount. In the event of a No Fault Occurrence, the Third Party F&amp;B Share shall be increased to 58%. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">22 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.02&#8195;<U>Team Merchandise</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Licensor shall have the exclusive right and obligation, at its sole cost and expense, to operate and manage the sale of Team
Merchandise at the Arena (excluding collectibles and game-used items) in a manner reasonably calculated to maximize revenues, but subject to providing a positive customer experience in accordance with the Standard. <U>Schedule 6.02</U> sets forth
the service and staffing for the sale of Team Merchandise for Regular Season Home Games as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Season. Licensor shall maintain at least substantially similar levels of service and staffing for all
Home Games provided that the Parties shall regularly coordinate and discuss with one another the appropriate levels of service and staffing and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. Notwithstanding anything herein
to the contrary, as between the Parties, the Rangers shall have the exclusive right to sell and control the sale of Team Merchandise online and anywhere else (other than at the Arena) and retain all revenue therefrom. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;The Rangers shall source, purchase and own all Team Merchandise it designates for sale at the Arena and consign it to Licensor for
sale. Licensor shall be responsible for reasonable storage and inventory control for Team Merchandise. The Rangers shall set the pricing of Team Merchandise. Licensor, at its sole cost, shall offer and sell Team Merchandise, and provide appropriate
sales staff and supervision, at points of sale in existing and replacement <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-Arena</FONT> stores and other locations designated or approved by the Rangers (such approval not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned
or delayed), on Home Dates and at other times pursuant to Section&nbsp;6.02(d). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Licensor shall retain 30% of revenues, net of
taxes and credit card fees, collected by Licensor from the sale of Team Merchandise sold at the Arena by or on behalf of Licensor and remit the remainder to the Rangers, provided that the Rangers shall retain all revenue from any collectibles or
game-used items received pursuant to any third-party agreement (e.g., Fanatics). Licensor shall be responsible for the payment of all taxes and credit card fees with respect to all such sales. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Licensor shall dedicate to Team Merchandise designated by the Rangers a minimum of 37.5% of the display space designated by Licensor
in consultation with the Rangers (the &#8220;<B>Team Merchandise Allocation</B>&#8221;) in the Madison Square Garden Store located in Chase Square and other subsequent stores located within the Arena that do not require an individual to have a
ticket to access such store. It is understood and agreed that the Rangers and the Knicks (to the extent that they remain affiliated entities) may allocate display space to each other on an <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">event-by-event</FONT></FONT> and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">day-by-day</FONT></FONT> basis; for the avoidance of doubt, Licensor shall not have access to more than 25% of the display
space in the Madison Square Garden Store, except as provided in subsection (e), below. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Licensor and the Rangers agree that no
Team Merchandise shall be required to be offered in such stores (or elsewhere in the Arena) while the Arena is being used for Other Arena Events. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">23 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;The Parties shall regularly coordinate and discuss with one another the
appropriate relative levels and locations of display space and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.03&#8195;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise</U></B>. Subject to Section&nbsp;6.02, Licensor
shall have the exclusive right to control the operation and sale of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise at the Arena at any time. Licensor shall retain all revenue from the sale of all
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise. Licensor may use up to 10% of the display space in concourses and other ticketed areas during Home Games for the sale of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Merchandise,
provided that such merchandise and the locations in which it is displayed and sold shall require the approval of the Rangers, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. The Parties shall regularly coordinate and discuss with one
another the appropriate relative levels and locations of display space and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.04&#8195;<U>Third-Party Contracts</U></B>. Licensor shall have the right to enter into a contract or contracts with one or
more third parties pursuant to which such third parties shall conduct and manage the sale of some or all Concessions and/or Catering Services, provided that Licensor shall be required to obtain the prior written approval of the Rangers, not to be
unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, for service providers that (i)&nbsp;do not or will not provide similar services during Other Arena Events or (ii)&nbsp;will conduct or manage the sale of a majority of F&amp;B Concessions or Team
Merchandise. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Licensor shall reasonably consult with the Rangers regarding the terms of any proposed agreement with any third party that shall conduct or manage the sale of a majority of F&amp;B Concessions or Team
Merchandise. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.05&#8195;<U>Operation on a Fair Basis; Standard of Service</U></B>. Licensor shall operate, or contract
with a third party for the operation of, Concessions and/or Catering Services on a basis that is fair to both Licensor and the Rangers and equivalent for Rangers Events and Other Arena Events. The quality of the service provided for Rangers Events
shall be consistent with the Standard. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;6.06&#8195;<U>Settlement</U></B>. Licensor shall, or shall cause any third party
conducting and managing the sale of Concessions and/or Catering Services to, remit to the Rangers all amounts from the sale of Concessions and/or Catering Services that the Rangers are entitled to under this <U>ARTICLE&nbsp;VI</U> in accordance with
Section&nbsp;9.06. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE VII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SIGNAGE AND SPONSORSHIPS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;7.01&#8195;<U>Definitions</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets</B>&#8221; means Advertising (including digital and fixed signage) visible or audible inside the
Arena during Home Games and Other Arena Events, but expressly excluding Team Sponsorship Assets, and Arena Naming Rights, which includes, </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">24 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
without limitation, (a)&nbsp;bridge signage and entitlements, (b)&nbsp;vomitorium signage, (c)&nbsp;GardenVision underbelly and other fixed signage and Advertising on fixtures and equipment,
(d)&nbsp;Advertising at concession areas and on Concession Items, (e)&nbsp;Advertising worn or carried by concessionaire personnel or other personnel engaged in the operation of Arena events and (f)&nbsp;naming rights and other entitlements of the
lobby, concourses, suite levels, clubs and all other spaces in the Arena. For avoidance of doubt, Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets shall not include any Advertising (i)&nbsp;outside of the building entrances to the Arena (e.g., marquee spots or
signage, outdoor digital board Advertising, breezeway signage or banners, Arena rooftop signage, etc.) which is not visible or audible inside the Arena bowl and sold to be visible or audible by seated Arena patrons, which Licensor shall have the
exclusive right to sell and retain all revenue from or (ii)&nbsp;that is a Team Sponsorship Asset, which the Rangers shall have the exclusive right to sell and retain all revenue from in accordance with Section&nbsp;7.02, whether or not such
Advertising may also be visible or audible inside the Arena during Other Arena Events. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Arena Naming Rights</B>&#8221; means the
right of a sponsor to have its brand integrated into the name of the Arena, e.g., the &#8220;J.P. Morgan Madison Square Garden&#8221;. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">In-Bowl</FONT> Variable Advertising</B>&#8221; means Advertising and other visual signage appearing
on, and other audio airing through or in connection with, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(a)&nbsp;in-Arena</FONT> electronic scoreboards, telescreens and any other message boards, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(b)&nbsp;in-Arena</FONT> LED
Signage, (c)&nbsp;any part of the Arena spectator bowl through projection technology, augmented reality and/or virtual reality, and (d)&nbsp;Arena audio or visual public address Advertising. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Sponsorship Assets</B>&#8221; means Advertising controlled by Licensor to the
extent that it creates no direct association with the Team, other than Team Sponsorship Assets, Arena Naming Rights and Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Rinkside Advertising</B>&#8221; means electronic, virtual, and static Advertising displayed at Rangers Events that appears inside
the Arena spectator bowl on: (a)&nbsp;seat back sleeves and other signage within the teams&#8217; bench areas (e.g., sports drink-branded coolers, cups, squeeze bottles, and towels); (b) on or under the ice; (c)&nbsp;on dasherboards and plexiglass
surrounding the ice hockey rink; (d)&nbsp;any moving or movable items (e.g., shovels, brooms and other <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">ice-cleaning</FONT> equipment, an indoor blimp/drone, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">t-shirt</FONT> machines,
the Zamboni ice machine); (e) within the penalty box; (f)&nbsp;between the team benches; (g)&nbsp;presentation of the &#8220;Rangers Blue Crew&#8221; (or other pep squad); (h) seat back sleeves in stands that are present for Home Games or Other
Rangers Events only; (i)&nbsp;any other Advertising provided under and subject to the NHL&#8217;s &#8220;Line of Sight Guidelines&#8221; and any other applicable League Rules; and (j)&nbsp;any other equipment, fixtures and items used by the Rangers
in the vicinity of the ice hockey rink not already covered in the definition of Team Sponsorship Assets. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Sponsorship Sales and
Service Representation Agreement</B>&#8221; means the agreement between Licensor&#8217;s affiliate, MSG Entertainment Group, LLC (&#8220;MSGE&#8221;) and the Rangers, entered into approximately contemporaneously herewith, whereby the Rangers
authorizes MSGE to enter into sponsorship agreements that include Team Sponsorship Assets. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">25 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Team Sponsorship Allocation Agreement</B>&#8221; means the agreement between MSGE
and MSG Sports, entered into approximately contemporaneously herewith, whereby MSG Sports agrees to deliver certain Team Sponsorship Assets in connection with certain current sponsorship agreements, and MSGE agrees to allocate and pay to the Rangers
certain amounts with respect to such agreements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Team Sponsorship Assets</B>&#8221; means, with respect to the Rangers or
Rangers Events only (in each case, including within three (3)&nbsp;hours before, during and within two (2)&nbsp;hours after each Rangers Event), (a) Rinkside Advertising; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(b)&nbsp;In-Bowl</FONT> Variable Advertising;
(c)&nbsp;Advertising on Team programs, schedules, yearbooks and tickets; (d)&nbsp;GardenVision underbelly and other fixed signage and Advertising on fixtures and equipment; (e)&nbsp;Advertising relating to the player introduction tunnel (connecting
locker room area to rink); (f) Advertising relating to Team game day contests and promotions (e.g., bobblehead night, hat night, puck-night, etc.); (g) Advertising that has been sold specifically with respect to only the Team (e.g., temporary Arena
bowl stair signage present only for Rangers Events); (h) concourse activations (i)&nbsp;Advertising relating to the Team and visiting team player locker rooms, training rooms and interview rooms; (j)&nbsp;the exhibition and promotion of products and
services at the Arena (e.g., kiosks and special areas in the concourse) during Rangers Events or on any date in which a Rangers Event is scheduled to the extent pertaining to any Rangers Event (but excluding food and beverage and merchandise
otherwise covered by this Agreement); (k) promotional or premium item give-aways at Rangers Events; (l)&nbsp;such other Advertising and sponsorship assets as currently exist or may later be developed that are Team- or Rangers Event-specific; and
(m)&nbsp;for the avoidance of doubt, all other advertising, sponsorship and promotional activity relating to the Team that is not related to the Arena (including advertising on Team uniforms, broadcasts, websites, mobile applications and social
media platforms). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;7.02&#8195;<U>Team Sponsorship Assets</U>.</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Subject to subsections (b)-(e) of this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7.02</U>, the Rangers shall have the exclusive right to sell and
retain all revenue from, and shall be responsible for all direct out of pocket costs and expenses related to, the operation and sale of Team Sponsorship Assets, including the right to enter into category-exclusive sponsorship agreements with respect
to Team Sponsorship Assets. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Licensor shall have the right to (i)&nbsp;alter digital signage platforms at any time (e.g., elimination of LED ring) at Licensor&#8217;s sole cost and expense, subject to reasonable advance
consultation with the Rangers and provided that if such alterations would eliminate or materially alter any Team Sponsorship Assets contained in any agreement under which the Rangers provide or are committed to provide Team Sponsorship Assets as of
the date of such alteration, Licensor will provide to the Rangers a replacement asset of equal or greater value (A)&nbsp;reasonably acceptable to the Rangers and (B)&nbsp;if such replacement is not permitted under such agreement, acceptable to the
sponsor party to such agreement and (ii)&nbsp;(x) approve, in its sole discretion, any permanent affixed signage in the Arena by the Rangers or (y)&nbsp;approve, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, any temporary
affixed signage by the Rangers on (1)&nbsp;the Arena bowl stairs, (2)&nbsp;level 7 (currently referred to as the &#8220;Lexus Level&#8221;) or (3)&nbsp;the bridge level (currently referred to as the &#8220;Chase Bridges&#8221;) (clauses (1), (2) and
(3)&nbsp;collectively, the &#8220;<B>Restricted Signage Areas</B>&#8221;); provided that (A)&nbsp;subject to 7.02(e), temporary </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">26 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
banners and the like shall not require Licensor approval and (B)&nbsp;if at any time during the Term, Licensor includes, sells or permits any temporary signage (including digital or programmable
signage) in the Restricted Signage Areas during Other Arena Events or otherwise, the Rangers shall have the right to include, sell or permit the same type of temporary signage in such Restricted Signage Areas in connection with Rangers Events
without Licensor approval (and, for the avoidance of doubt, any such signage shall be considered Team Sponsorship Assets). For the avoidance of doubt, any concourse, lobby or similar activations shall be subject to <U>Sections 4.06(a)</U> <U>and
4.06(b)</U>. Licensor shall provide and maintain the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-Arena</FONT> signage, assets and other elements associated with Team Sponsorship Assets (to the extent in the control of Licensor) in accordance with the
Standard. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;The Parties acknowledge and agree that their rights and obligations under this Section&nbsp;7.02 shall be subject and
subordinate to the Sponsorship Sales and Service Representation Agreement and the Team Sponsorship Allocation Agreement (collectively, the <B>&#8220;Arena Agency Agreements&#8221;</B>), as of the Effective Date and throughout the respective terms of
such agreements. Pursuant to such Arena Agency Agreements, the Rangers shall be (i)&nbsp;required to provide Team Sponsorship Assets inventory committed to, and to comply with promotional category exclusivities granted to, certain Licensor sponsors
(<B>&#8220;Joint Sponsors&#8221;</B>) in accordance with such Joint Sponsors&#8217; respective agreements (each, a &#8220;<B>Joint Sponsorship Agreement</B>&#8221;) with Licensor and (ii)&nbsp;entitled to certain allocations of revenue received by
Licensor pursuant to such agreements; each of (i)&nbsp;and (ii) as set forth in more detail in the Team Sponsorship Allocation Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Subject to League Rules, the name and logo of any Arena Naming Rights partner or &#8220;Marquee&#8221;-level sponsor shall be
exhibited on Team&#8217;s home playing surface near Team&#8217;s <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">center-ice</FONT> logo at the Arena (with 100% of the allocable revenue therefrom delivered to the Rangers). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;The Parties shall meet and confer regularly (contemplated to be no less frequently than once per calendar quarter) to discuss in
good faith opportunities to maximize the collective value of their sponsorships by combining the sales of Team Sponsorship Assets, Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets and/or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Sponsorship Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, in no event shall the Rangers cover or interfere with any Arena Game
Sponsorship Assets with any temporary, virtual or any other type of signage. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, in no event shall Licensor cover or interfere with any Team Sponsorship Assets with any temporary, virtual or any
other type of signage. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;7.03</B>&#8195;<B><U>Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets</U></B>. Licensor shall
have the exclusive right to sell all Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets, provided that Licensor shall not, without the Rangers&#8217; prior written approval, (a)&nbsp;enter into any agreement that includes any Team Sponsorship Assets or
(b)&nbsp;enter into any agreement or modify any arena inventory or signage existing as of the date hereof if such agreement or modification would reasonably be expected to (i)&nbsp;cause a breach under any agreement that includes Team Sponsorship
Assets, (ii)&nbsp;eliminate, or substantially impair (i.e. effectively eliminate all or most of the value of) any physical Team </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">27 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
Sponsorship Assets in the Arena or (iii)&nbsp;limit or restrict the Rangers&#8217; ability to include Team Sponsorship Assets in any exclusive or
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive</FONT> advertising or sponsorship agreements, in each case under clauses (i), (ii) or (iii), unless Licensor provides to the Rangers a replacement asset of equal or greater value (A)&nbsp;reasonably
acceptable to the Rangers and (B)&nbsp;if such replacement is not permitted under such agreement, acceptable to the sponsor party to such agreement. The Rangers shall not enter into any agreement (and has not as of the Effective Date) that contains
Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets or would cause a breach under any agreement that includes Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets without Licensor&#8217;s prior written approval. The Rangers shall be entitled to (i) 22.5% of net revenue from the
sale of Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets (the &#8220;<B>Rangers Arena Game Sponsorships Share</B>&#8221;), i.e., gross revenue therefrom less any of the following paid by Licensor: taxes and applicable fees; and actual <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> costs for signage fabrication, installation and removal costs; provided that, if (a)&nbsp;an Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Asset is not visible, audible or
otherwise present during substantially all Other Arena Events, (b)&nbsp;an Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Asset is not visible, audible or otherwise present for a similar length of time during Other Arena Events and Rangers Events, or (c)&nbsp;such
Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets does not include substantially all Rangers Events, then, in each instance, the revenues shall be proportionally allocated to each event included in such agreement, in a reasonable manner and as mutually agreed by
Licensor and the Rangers, and the Rangers shall receive the appropriate proportional amount of revenues attributable to the Rangers Events (e.g., treatment of the JP Morgan Club, as currently operated). In the event of a No Fault Occurrence, the
Rangers Arena Game Shared Sponsorships Share shall be increased to 30.5% (and in the case of any proportional allocation of revenues pursuant to the proviso in the foregoing sentence, the Parties will agree on an appropriate increase in favor of the
Rangers to such allocation). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;7.04</B>&#8195;<B></B><B><U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT>
Sponsorship Assets</U></B><B>.</B> The Rangers shall have no rights whatsoever with respect to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Sponsorship Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;7.05</B>&#8195;<B><U>Arena Naming Rights</U></B><B>. </B>The Rangers shall be entitled to 17.5%<SUP
STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top"> </SUP>of revenue from the sale of any Arena Naming Rights, excluding any amounts already allocable to the Rangers pursuant to the terms of this Agreement or otherwise. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;7.06</B>&#8195;<B><U>Other Revenue</U></B><B>.</B> The Parties shall discuss in good faith the allocation of
other Advertising income, revenues and fees derived from operations at the Arena that are not otherwise provided herein, to the extent attributable to Rangers Events. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;7.07</B>&#8195;<B><U>Signage and Sponsorship Settlement Process</U></B><B>.</B> Licensor shall remit to the
Rangers a cash payment equal to all amounts collected or received from the sale of Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets and Arena Naming Rights that the Rangers are entitled to under this ARTICLE VII in accordance with Section&nbsp;9.06. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">28 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE VIII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>BROADCASTING </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;8.01&#8195;<U>Broadcast Rights</U><U> and Facilities</U></B>.<B></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;As between the Parties, the Rangers shall own and control all rights with respect to the broadcasts and telecasts of each Rangers
Event by any means whatsoever (including, without limitation, radio; over the air, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pay-per-view,</FONT></FONT> and basic and pay cable television; and streaming and other forms of
electronic and digital media now known or hereafter created) (the &#8220;<B>Broadcast Rights</B>&#8221;) and shall retain all revenues in connection with such Broadcast Rights. The Rangers may not authorize or purport to authorize their media
rightsholder to include in telecasts or broadcasts of Home Games any &#8220;virtual signage&#8221; in the Restricted Signage Areas without the prior written consent of Licensor, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or
delayed. For the avoidance of doubt, the foregoing sentence shall not apply to (i)&nbsp;any virtual signage being used as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Season (i.e., one (1)&nbsp;position on the glass at each end of the ice
and one (1)&nbsp;position between the benches) without the prior written consent of Licensor, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed or (ii)&nbsp;any League telecasts or broadcasts (including, without limitation, any national
and international telecasts or broadcasts) or any visiting team telecasts or broadcasts, with respect to which the Rangers and Licensor each reserve all rights. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Licensor shall ensure that the press areas, broadcast areas, playing surfaces, Team Areas and Common Areas continue to be wired or
otherwise equipped throughout the Term for the production of such broadcasts and telecasts in accordance with League Rules. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Licensor shall cooperate with the Rangers and provide access for the producers of such broadcasts and telecasts to such truck
loading docks, camera positions, and other Arena facilities reasonably required for the production of such broadcasts and telecasts in accordance with League Rules, at the Rangers&#8217; or its broadcaster&#8217;s expense. Subject to League Rules,
Licensor shall cooperate with and provide access for broadcast and telecast producers acting on behalf of all other duly authorized parties (e.g., opposing teams and the NHL) at such games. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Notwithstanding the foregoing, Licensor retains the right to assign and reassign facilities, locations and spaces for the conduct of
broadcasting in a manner consistent with League Rules; provided that Licensor will consult with the Rangers prior to any proposed changes to the locations and spaces for the conduct of broadcasting during Home Games. For example, and without
limiting the previous sentence, Licensor is not obligated to continue to provide the rinkside studio, or the studio facilities on the bridge level, in their current locations. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;8.02&#8195;<U>Broadcast Renovations</U></B>.<B> </B>At the Rangers&#8217; written request, Licensor shall make such
alterations to the Arena&#8217;s broadcast facilities and equipment as are reasonably necessary to comply with League Rules, and any broadcast agreements between the Rangers and/or the League and a broadcaster, provided that the Rangers shall be
responsible for any upfront and continuing costs related to such alterations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE IX </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>LICENSOR SERVICES </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.01&#8195;<U>General Services</U></B>.<B></B> During the Term, Licensor, at its sole cost and expense (except as otherwise
expressly provided herein), shall provide the following services, to and for </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">29 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
the benefit of the Rangers (and the Arena generally), each in accordance with the Standard (&#8220;<B>General Services</B>&#8221;), provided that the Parties shall regularly coordinate and
discuss with one another the appropriate levels and quality of staffing, equipment and service and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Heating, ventilation, and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">air-conditioning.</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Subject to unavailability due to causes beyond Licensor&#8217;s reasonable control, utilities, including electricity, gas, steam,
chilled water, hot and cold water, lighting, sewer, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Wi-Fi</FONT> (or comparable data delivery pipeline or service) service accessible to Rangers employees and patrons during Rangers Events, telephone and
intercommunications equipment, elevators, and escalators. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Lighting equipment and apparatus, including as may be required by
League Rules. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Maintenance and repair of the Arena and all of its components in compliance with all applicable governmental
laws, ordinances, and regulations and in clean and good condition, subject to ordinary wear and tear, subject to the Rangers&#8217; obligation to pay for maintenance and repairs necessitated by Rangers Misuse. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Twenty-four (24)&nbsp;hour per day, year-round protection and security of the Arena and all its facilities (including Team Areas),
and all property of the Rangers and Rangers personnel located in the Arena. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;Reasonable grounds maintenance and snow and ice
removal, including, but not limited to, keeping sidewalks and other areas immediately surrounding the Arena in compliance with all applicable governmental laws, ordinances, and regulations and reasonably free of snow, ice, debris, dirt, litter, and
trash. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g)&#8195;Box office services in accordance with Section&nbsp;5.05(a). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h)&#8195;Repair and maintenance, in each case in accordance with League Rules, of the playing surfaces and related equipment (including the
ice surface, Zambonis, goals, dasherboards, and glass), and all <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">back-up</FONT> equipment and to the Rangers&#8217; reasonable satisfaction in accordance with League Rules, all such costs to be borne or reimbursed by
the Rangers, except to the extent repair or replacement is necessitated by the negligence of Licensor or its agents or other parties permitted by Licensor to use the foregoing (e.g., college teams using hockey rink), or required by League Rules.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)&#8195;Without limiting the generality of Section&nbsp;9.01(h), the Parties agree that Licensor shall own and maintain the &#8220;ice
plant&#8221; and &#8220;ice floor&#8221; and related equipment supporting the operation of the ice rink but that the Rangers shall bear or reimburse Licensor for the cost of the labor, supplies and equipment required for such operation, including
for cleaning the pipes and other <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">ice-system</FONT> elements and for purchasing and recycling the brine used in the ice system. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">30 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j)&#8195;All other services and functions needed to operate, repair and maintain the Arena
in accordance with the Standard, including pest control and obtaining and maintaining all necessary licenses and permits. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(k)&#8195;Without limiting any of the foregoing, Licensor shall operate, maintain and improve the Arena in accordance with the Standard at all
times throughout the Term. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.02&#8195;<U>Game Day Services</U></B>. In addition to the General Services provided pursuant
to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.01</U>, Licensor shall provide to and for the benefit of the Rangers, the following <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">day-of-game</FONT></FONT> services on the dates of all Rangers
Events, each in accordance with the Standard (&#8220;<B>Game Day Services</B>&#8221;), for which the Rangers shall reimburse Licensor&#8217;s actual <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT>
operating cost (except as otherwise provided in this Agreement (e.g., operation of Suites, Advertising, Concessions and General Services)) without markup or overhead, as the same may be adjusted pursuant to Section&nbsp;9.04: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(a)&#8195;Set-up</FONT> of playing surfaces for the Rangers&#8217; use on Home Dates (and for Other Rangers
Events), by or before the time required in Section&nbsp;4.02(a), in accordance with League Rules, and subject to the Rangers&#8217; reasonable satisfaction. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Operating <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-house</FONT> broadcast production facilities in the Arena in accordance with Article
VIII (currently known as &#8220;GardenVision&#8221;) at a level consistent with past practice, it being understood that the Rangers maintain exclusive rights and remain responsible for providing the direction and production of all game presentation
elements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Operating the Arena during and cleaning up the Arena after, a Home Game and Other Rangers Events, including the
following event-specific personnel and their successors in name or function: security personnel, building security personnel, street patrol personnel (including supervisors), paid NYPD detail, anti-bomb canines and handlers, ushers, ticket takers,
concourse &#8220;Directors,&#8221; elevator operators, restroom attendants, event office administrators, guest experience representatives, guest service supervisors, security supervisors, concourse supervisors, concourse managers, laborers/utility
workers, carpenters, electricians, custodial porters, telecommunications technicians, spotlight operators and stagehands (as required based on the production elements for such Home Game or Other Rangers Event), and other necessary labor and
third-party services, including overnight labor and supervisors, medical and emergency services staff or contractors and rubbish removal, all in a manner consistent with past practice, but not including game officials, referees, or timekeepers. The
Rangers shall only be responsible for the costs relating to the foregoing personnel to the extent allocable to Rangers Events. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;If requested by the Rangers, Game Day box office personnel incremental to the staffing provided as General Services pursuant to
Section&nbsp;9.01(g) in a manner consistent with past practice. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Any additional services reasonably requested by the Rangers in
writing and approved by Licensor, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">31 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;With respect to all Game Day Services, all costs charged to the Rangers shall be
nondiscriminatory and consistent with rates incurred by Licensor for all other events at the Arena. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.03&#8195;<U>Delta
Club and JP Morgan Club</U></B>. During Rangers Events, the Rangers shall be permitted to provide certain ticketholders (subject to physical capacity constraints) with access to (a)&nbsp;the club currently known as the Delta Sky 360 Club and
(b)&nbsp;the club currently known as the JP Morgan Club (collectively, the &#8220;<B>VIP Clubs</B>&#8221;). Ticketholders who have access to the VIP Clubs shall be entitled to a certain amount of complimentary food and beverage. The Rangers shall
have the sole discretion in determining the price charged to ticketholders for access to, as well as the menu offered in, the VIP Clubs, and shall retain all revenues therefrom. Licensor shall operate the VIP Clubs in accordance with the Standard
(the &#8220;<B>VIP Club Services</B>&#8221;), for which the Rangers shall reimburse Licensor&#8217;s actual cost, without markup or overhead, attributable to such Rangers Events. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;9.04</B>&#8195;<B><U>Staffing Levels for Certain Services</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Schedule 9.04 sets forth the staffing levels for Game Day Services, VIP Club Services and Suite 200 for Home Games as of the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Season. Licensor shall maintain substantially similar levels of staffing for all Home Games, provided that the Parties shall regularly coordinate and discuss with one another the appropriate levels of
staffing and accommodate the other&#8217;s reasonable requests for adjustment thereto. Licensor shall be responsible for retaining, managing and supervising all personnel in Licensor&#8217;s provision of the General Services, Game Day Services, VIP
Club Services and Suite 200. Licensor shall use reasonable efforts to accommodate the Rangers&#8217; reasonable requests with respect to the provision of all Game Day Services. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Licensor shall not do or fail to do anything that will result in or will cause the Arena not being reasonably fit or otherwise
available for use for Home Games in accordance with the League Rules as and when required to enable the Rangers to comply with its obligations under this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.05&#8195;<U>Budgeting and Estimates</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Following reasonable consultation with the Rangers, Licensor shall provide the Rangers with reasonably detailed annual estimates of
revenues and expenses by month and Home Game (the &#8220;<B>Annual Budget</B>&#8221;) related to Game Day Services, VIP Club Services, Suite 200 and any other revenues to be recouped and expenses to be paid by the Rangers under this Agreement (such
costs and expenses, collectively, the &#8220;<B>Rangers Costs</B>&#8221;). The Annual Budget shall be provided at such times as may be reasonably required by the Rangers in accordance with the Rangers&#8217; reasonable budgeting and forecasting
processes. Upon receipt of the Annual Budget, the Rangers shall have a period of fifteen (15)&nbsp;days to review each estimate and forecast, and identify any objections it has to the Annual Budget. The Rangers and Licensor will then negotiate for a
period of fifteen (15)&nbsp;days regarding any disagreements in respect of the Annual Budget. Subject to Section&nbsp;9.05(b) below, if the Rangers and Licensor are unable to agree with respect to a particular cost within an Annual Budget within
such period, the corresponding line item from the most recent approved Annual Budget will control with respect to such line item until such time, </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">32 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
if any, that the Rangers and Licensor agree on such proposed line item; provided, that: (1)&nbsp;if such line item in the Annual Budget did not appear in the corresponding most recent approved
Annual Budget, then Licensor shall not be entitled to payment or reimbursement for expenses in such line item and Licensor shall have no obligation to provide such product or service until the proposed line item is approved by the Rangers (not to be
unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed); and (2)&nbsp;if such line item appeared in the prior Annual Budget, then Licensor shall be entitled to payment or reimbursement in an amount not to exceed the applicable line item of the prior approved
Annual Budget multiplied by 104%. The Annual Budget for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2019-20</FONT> Contract Year is attached hereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195; Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Rangers agree that it shall have no approval rights over (i)&nbsp;any collectively bargained
labor or employment costs or collectively bargained work rates, (ii)&nbsp;any staff or service that is deemed by Licensor, in its reasonable discretion, as necessary to the safety and/or security of any Rangers Event(s) or (iii)&nbsp;costs of goods
for any Product purchased from an unaffiliated third party. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;The Rangers Costs shall be consistent with the costs incurred for
Other Arena Events, it being understood that costs will differ based on the nature and need of the events and circumstances outside of the reasonable control of Licensor (e.g., Force Majeure). The amount payable by the Rangers to Licensor for Game
Day Services and VIP Club Services shall be determined on a monthly basis in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.06</U>. The Rangers&#8217; consent shall be required for any deviation from the approved Annual Budget and, without such
approval, the Rangers shall not be responsible for any costs or expenses in excess of such line items in the approved Annual Budget. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.06&#8195;<U>Settlement</U></B>.<B> </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Not later than the fifteenth (15th) day of each calendar month, Licensor shall provide the Rangers a report
(&#8220;<B>Monthly Report</B>&#8221;) calculating (i)&nbsp;each item of revenue (including any deductions therefrom) that is shared with or allocated or payable to the Rangers in accordance with this Agreement with respect to the immediately
preceding calendar month and (ii)&nbsp;each item of cost or expense incurred by Licensor during the immediately preceding calendar month for which Licensor is entitled to payment or reimbursement (in whole or in part) from the Rangers in accordance
with this Agreement (clauses (i)&nbsp;and (ii) collectively, the &#8220;<B>Applicable Amounts</B>&#8221;). Each Monthly Report shall include a reasonable amount of detail describing each of the Applicable Amounts and copies of ledgers, invoices or
other reasonable evidence of each of the Applicable Amounts. Each Monthly Report delivered by Licensor to the Rangers shall set forth for each Joint Sponsorship Agreement during such Monthly Period, (x)&nbsp;the Revenues under such Joint Sponsorship
Agreement allocated to the Rangers, on the one hand, and Licensor, on the other hand and (y)&nbsp;the Team entitlements (including Team Sponsorship Assets, Tickets, ticket banks, etc. provided to such Joint Sponsor) and Arena entitlements (including
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Team</FONT> Sponsorship Assets, Arena Game Shared Sponsorship Assets, Suites, etc. provided to such Joint Sponsor) contributed and their respective rate card values or fair market value (as applicable) under such
Joint Sponsorship Agreement. Licensor shall pay the Rangers the net amount payable under each Monthly Report on or prior to the fifteenth (15<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP>) day of each calendar month (i.e., the date in which
the related Monthly Report is required to be provided to the Rangers). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

determination of any Applicable Amounts, the Parties shall refer such disputed matters set forth in Sections 9.06(a) and 9.06(b) to a mutually agreed upon national independent accounting firm (the &#8220;<B>Accounting Firm</B>&#8221;), and the
Parties shall cooperate with the Accounting Firm to enable such Accounting Firm to resolve the dispute as promptly as practicable. The Accounting Firm shall address only those items in dispute and may not assign a value greater than the greatest
value for such item claimed by either Party or smaller than the smallest value for such item claimed by either Party. In the absence of manifest error, the resolution of disputed items by the Accounting Firm shall constitute an arbitral award that
is final, binding and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-appealable.</FONT> The costs and expenses of the Accounting Firm incurred pursuant to this Section&nbsp;9.06 shall be borne by the Rangers, on the one hand, and the Licensor, on the other
hand, in proportion to the allocation by the Accounting Firm of the net dollar amount of disputed matters, such that the prevailing party (or parties) pay a lesser proportion (or none, as applicable) of such costs and expenses.

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;9.07&#8195;<U>Provision of Licensor Services</U></B>.<B> </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Licensor shall have the right to delegate, subcontract, or sublicense to a third party, including Licensor&#8217;s Affiliates, the
provision of Licensor Services and no such delegation, subcontract or sublicense shall relieve Licensor of any of its obligations hereunder; provided that Licensor shall be required to obtain consent of the Rangers (not to be unreasonably withheld,
conditioned or delayed) in connection with the delegation, subcontracting, or sublicensing of Licensor Services to any third party service providers that (i)&nbsp;do not or will not provide similar services during Other Arena Events or
(ii)&nbsp;will provide, conduct or manage the majority of a particular material Licensor Service. Subject to the preceding sentence, Licensor shall make the final decision regarding the selection of any such third party. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Licensor shall make reasonable efforts to minimize interference with the Rangers&#8217; use of the Arena, and in no event shall
Licensor materially interfere with the Rangers&#8217; ability to conduct or broadcast Rangers Events or materially reduce or interfere with the Rangers&#8217; permitted use of the Arena or ingress thereto or egress therefrom, subject to
Licensor&#8217;s Arena safety and security protocols in accordance with Section&nbsp;4.06(b). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;For clarity, as between Licensor
and the Rangers, the Rangers shall have the right to fully control all Home Game entertainment and hockey operations (including scoreboard and audio operations), with assistance from Licensor&#8217;s production staff through the applicable General
Services and/or Game Day Services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE X </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PROMOTION; TRADEMARKS; DATA OWNERSHIP </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;10.01&#8195;<U>Promotional Outlets</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">In-Game</FONT> Promotion</U>. The Rangers shall provide in the Rangers&#8217; game-night
communications outlets (e.g., GardenVision features, announcements, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-crowd</FONT> appearances, etc.), reasonable promotion of Other Arena Events, Licensor&#8217;s and its Affiliates&#8217; other events, venues,
charities and businesses and overall promotion for Licensor and its Affiliates (&#8220;<B>Licensor Promotion</B>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Broadcast Promotion</U>. Licensor shall be permitted to use a portion of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-game</FONT>
commercial spots, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-game</FONT> announcer <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">drop-ins</FONT> and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;run-of-schedule&#8221;</FONT></FONT> commercial
spots made available to Team pursuant to its Media Rights Agreement with MSG Networks for purposes of Licensor Promotion. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Licensor Promotional Outlets</U>. The Rangers shall have the sole rights and be solely responsible for, all publicity, public
relations, and promotional campaigns for Rangers Events. Notwithstanding the foregoing, to the extent of available inventory and with no <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> cost to Licensor,
Licensor shall include reasonable promotion of the Team and its Rangers Events on the Arena&#8217;s marketing and communication outlets, including Licensor&#8217;s and its Affiliates&#8217; websites and applications;
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-arena</FONT> signage; the digital marquee facing Seventh Avenue and other Arena exterior digital and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-digital</FONT> signage. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">35 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;At the commencement of the Term, Licensor&#8217;s use of the Rangers&#8217; <FONT

<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;10.02&#8195;<U>Trademark Licenses</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The Rangers hereby grant to Licensor for the Term a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive</FONT> royalty-free license to use
all Team-related intellectual property owned or licensed by the Rangers, including but not limited to images, likenesses, service marks, tradenames and trademarks (the &#8220;<B>Rangers IP</B>&#8221;), for the purposes of (i)&nbsp;promoting the
Arena as the home arena of the Team, (ii)&nbsp;operating the Arena, and (iii)&nbsp;providing the Licensor Services. In all instances Licensor&#8217;s use of such Rangers IP shall be in accordance with League Rules. Licensor is solely responsible for
clearing any third-party rights that may be used in connection with the Rangers IP. Licensor shall not have any right to sublicense, or seek or receive any payments from third parties specifically for the use of, the Rangers IP, except in accordance
with ARTICLE VII, it being understood that the license granted hereunder shall include the right for Licensor to promote the Arena as the home arena of the Team in places and in a manner that may also incorporate in an incidental manner promotion of
Licensor&#8217;s marketing partners and sponsors (including, without limitation, use in connection with the Rangers IP any overall Arena marketing partner(s) <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;lock-up</FONT> logo&#8221; or naming rights,
sponsored Licensor web pages and upcoming events promotions, etc.) so long as no association is created between the Rangers and any third party, except in accordance with League Rules. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;The Rangers shall be required and permitted to reference the Arena as their home venue on all material promoting the Team and ticket
sales. In connection therewith, Licensor and its Affiliates hereby grant to the Rangers a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive</FONT> royalty-free license to use the trademarks &#8220;MADISON SQUARE GARDEN,&#8221; &#8220;MSG,&#8221;
&#8220;THE WORLD&#8217;S MOST FAMOUS ARENA&#8221; and related logos solely for such promotional purposes. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;The Parties shall
mutually agree on an appropriate approval process regarding the use of the other Party&#8217;s intellectual property in order to maintain quality control standards. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;10.03&#8195;<U>Customer Data</U></B>. As between the Parties, ownership and access to data relating to customers and
prospective customers shall be governed as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<U>Team-Owned Data</U>. Any and all customer data and information
(including contact information and any other personally identifiable information) (&#8220;<B>Customer Data</B>&#8221;) generated, </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">36 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
developed or collected solely in connection with the sale or marketing of tickets for Home Games and Other Rangers Events and the sale of single-night or multiple-date Suites for Home Games and
Other Rangers Events shall, as between the Parties, be owned by the Rangers. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;<U>Licensor-Owned Data</U>. Customer Data
generated, developed or collected solely in connection with Licensor&#8217;s sale or marketing of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(i)&nbsp;non-Team</FONT> related tickets; (ii)&nbsp;Suites other than Suites for Home Games and Other Rangers Events
only; and (iii)&nbsp;memberships to the Madison Club, The Loft and any similar product shall, as between the Parties, be owned by Licensor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;<U>Jointly-Owned Data</U>. Customer Data generated, developed or collected in connection with the sale or marketing of any ticket or
hospitality product (other than those set forth in subsections (a)&nbsp;and (b) of this Section&nbsp;10.03) that includes admission to Home Games and Other Arena Events shall be owned jointly by the Parties. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;<U>Data Use and Sharing</U>. Each Party shall, to the fullest extent permitted by law and its privacy policy, share their owned
Customer Data with the other Party for use by the other Party and their affiliates, subject to the prior approval in each case by the Customer Data-owning Party, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed, provided, that any sale or
licensing to a third party of Customer Data owned by the other Party is subject to the prior written consent of the Customer Data-owning Party in their sole discretion. Each Party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that all Customer
Data is collected in such a manner that it may be shared with the other Party under this Section&nbsp;10.03 and applicable law. For purposes of clarity, the Party that is the owner of Customer Data pursuant to this Section&nbsp;10.03 or otherwise
may use such data for any and all purposes, including the sale or licensing of such data to third parties, subject to compliance with applicable law and such Party&#8217;s privacy policy. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Confidentiality and Data Protection. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Parties agree to establish appropriate safeguards to protect the confidentiality of shared Customer Data
and to prevent unauthorized use, disclosure or access. Specifically, each Party shall implement and maintain an information security management policy with standards that are no less rigorous than accepted industry practices, comply with all
applicable laws to protect the Customer Data from unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure, and comply with the provisions of this Agreement. At a minimum, each Party shall implement physical, technical, and administrative
information safeguards that provide for: (a)&nbsp;protection of business facilities, paper files, servers, computing equipment, including all mobile devices and other equipment with information storage capability, and backup systems containing
Customer Data; (b)&nbsp;network, application (including databases), and platform security; (c)&nbsp;business systems designed to optimize security; (d)&nbsp;secure, encrypted transmission and secure, encrypted storage of Customer Data; (e)&nbsp;a
minimum of two factor authentication and access control mechanisms; and (f)&nbsp;personnel security, including background checks on all such personnel, use of unique, robust </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">37 </P>

<TD WIDTH="18%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">
passwords, and annual training on how to comply with a Party&#8217;s physical, technical, and administrative information security safeguards. Each Party shall regularly test and monitor the
effectiveness of their security practices and procedures relating to the Customer Data, and will evaluate and adjust their information security program in light of the results of the testing and monitoring, any material changes to their operations
or business arrangements, or any other circumstances that a Party knows or reasonably should know may have a material effect on their information security program. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">As of and following the Effective Date, each Party (the &#8220;<U>Affected Party</U>&#8221;) shall provide
immediate written notice to the other Party upon discovery or notification (either of the foregoing, &#8220;<U>Discovery</U>&#8221;) of any (i)&nbsp;unauthorized or unlawful access to, or acquisition, use or disclosure of, Customer Data or
(ii)&nbsp;event which, after Discovery, would lead a reasonable person to conclude that there was, or likely was, unauthorized or unlawful access to, or acquisition, use or disclosure of, Customer Data (either of the foregoing, a &#8220;<U>Data
Breach</U>&#8221;). Such notice shall include (and be supplemented in writing to the other Party on an ongoing basis as reasonably requested by the other Party), to the extent known by the Affected Party and reasonably relevant to such breach:
(i)&nbsp;the general circumstances and extent of any Data Breach or intrusion into the Affected Party&#8217;s systems that are used to protect, store, process or use Customer Data; (ii)&nbsp;the types and volume of Customer Data involved in the Data
Breach; (iii)&nbsp;the Affected Party&#8217;s plans for corrective actions to respond to the Data Breach; (iv)&nbsp;the identities of all individuals whose Customer Data was or may have been affected by the Data Breach; (v)&nbsp;steps taken to
secure Customer Data and preserve information for any necessary investigation; and (vi)&nbsp;any other related information reasonably requested by the other Party. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Affected Party shall, at its own expense, reasonably cooperate with the other Party in connection with any
notice to third parties of such Data Breach and any other remediation efforts required by applicable law. Without limiting the foregoing, the Affected Party shall, at its own expense, promptly reimburse the other Party for all costs and expenses
(including legal fees) reasonably incurred by the other Party in connection with the Data Breach, including without limitation costs and expenses (including legal fees) reasonably incurred in connection with any notices to third parties or other
remediation efforts required by applicable law. Neither Party will name the other in any press release or other public disclosure without prior written approval, except to the extent required by applicable law. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

activities and other circumstances </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD WIDTH="18%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">
that caused or gave rise to the Data Breach as promptly as reasonably practicable after Discovery and in accordance with industry standards, the provisions of this Agreement and applicable law.
Without limiting the foregoing, the Affected Party shall promptly take commercially reasonable corrective actions, and will reasonably cooperate with the other Party in reasonable and lawful efforts to prevent, eradicate, mitigate and rectify such
Data Breach. </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
