<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(v)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Affected Party shall, at its own expense, reasonably cooperate with the other Party in investigating and
responding to each Data Breach, including by (i)&nbsp;providing information and responding to inquiries and (ii)&nbsp;obtaining copies of information, data and records, in each case as reasonably requested by the other Party. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;To the extent permitted by applicable law and each Party&#8217;s respective privacy policy, the Parties shall also share with each
other the results of fan and guest surveys, focus groups, etc. to the extent the information relates to guests&#8217; experiences in connection with Home Games (including customer service, quality of Concessions, cleanliness, game presentation,
arriving and departing, etc.). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XI </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EXCLUSIVITY COVENANT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;11.01&#8195;<U>Covenant</U></B>. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, including
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;20.10</U> with respect to League Rules, the Rangers hereby agree during the Term that the Team shall not play any Home Games in any location other than the Arena, except as provided in <U>ARTICLE XII</U> or <U>Section
</U>20.01. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Rangers agree to fully comply with the obligations undertaken by its predecessor Madison Square Garden Center, Inc. under the Property Tax Exemption Agreement as
the owner of the Team. Licensor agrees to fully comply and cause full compliance with all other obligations undertaken by its predecessor Madison Square Garden Center, Inc. under the Property Tax Exemption Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CASUALTY AND CONDEMNATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;12.01&#8195;<U>Termination or Restoration Due to Condemnation</U></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;In the event that title to all or substantially all of the Arena or the right of Licensor to occupy or possess all or substantially
all of the Arena shall be taken by Condemnation (a &#8220;<B>Total Taking</B>&#8221;), Licensor shall provide prompt notice of such Total Taking to the Rangers, and, except in the case of a Temporary Taking, this Agreement shall terminate and be of
no further force upon the earlier of (i)&nbsp;the date when the possession of all or such substantial portion of the Arena or right so taken shall be required for such use or purpose or (b)&nbsp;the effective date of the Total Taking. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">39 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;In the event of a Condemnation other than a Total Taking, this Agreement shall
continue in full force and effect; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that if any such Condemnation results in an Untenantable Condition (including for this purpose a Temporary Taking that results in an Untenantable Condition for a period in excess of
(i) 24 months, or (ii)&nbsp;in the case of any such Temporary Taking that occurs during the last five (5)&nbsp;Contract Years of the Term, 12 months) then each Party shall have the right, in its sole discretion, to terminate this Agreement by notice
to the other given within 30 days after the date of the Rangers&#8217; receipt of the Estimate (as defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.05(a)</U>) with respect to such Condemnation, without any further liability hereunder, except for any
liability hereunder which, by the specific terms of this Agreement survives termination; <U>provided further</U>, <U>however</U>, that neither Party shall have such termination right if (x)&nbsp;the then applicable legal requirements, zoning laws,
building regulations and other governmental or quasi-governmental ordinances, rules or regulations (collectively, &#8220;<B>Governmental Rules</B>&#8221;) do not prohibit or materially restrict the performance of the Condemnation Restoration Work
(as defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.01(c)</U>), (y) the Estimated Date (as defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.05(a)</U>) with respect to such Condemnation shall be a date that occurs on or before the date that is (i) 30 months

Arena can be restored in a manner as shall satisfy the requirements of the definition of Condemnation Restoration Work. Further, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in the foregoing, if the Estimated Restoration Cost with respect
to such Condemnation exceeds 30% of the full replacement value of the portions of the Arena that are not subject to such Condemnation, then Licensor shall have the right, in its sole discretion, to terminate this Agreement by notice to the Rangers
given within 90 days after the date of the Rangers&#8217; receipt of the Estimate with respect to such Condemnation, without any further liability hereunder, except for any liability hereunder which, by the specific terms of this Agreement survives
termination. If either Party terminates this Agreement as provided in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.01(b)</U>, then such termination shall be effective on the date specified in such Party&#8217;s notice of termination, but no earlier than
thirty (30)&nbsp;days after the date of such notice and no later than one hundred eighty (180)&nbsp;days after the date of such notice, as if said date were the date fixed for the expiration of the Term </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;If neither party has the right to terminate this Agreement, or if neither party shall timely elect to terminate this Agreement, as
provided in paragraph (b)&nbsp;above, Licensor shall, at its sole cost and expense, commence as soon as reasonably practicable and with reasonable diligence proceed to perform the work (the &#8220;<B>Condemnation Restoration Work</B>&#8221;) to and
repair and restore the part of the Arena not taken to an architecturally complete unit and, to the extent commercially practicable, to substantially its former condition, as and to the extent necessary to remedy the Untenantable Condition, using
materials, equipment and construction techniques which are common at the time of such Condemnation and with such changes as may be required by then applicable Governmental Rules or that Licensor may otherwise deem appropriate in each case, in a
manner consistent with and as necessary to maintain the Standard; it being agreed, however, that Licensor shall be required to obtain the prior written consent of the Rangers to any changes that are not required by then applicable Governmental Rules
and that could materially adversely impact the Rangers&#8217; rights or obligations under this Agreement. Licensor shall (i)&nbsp;keep the Rangers reasonably apprised of the progress and the estimated date of completion of the Condemnation

of such Casualty provides for an Estimated Date that will occur during the period commencing on the 181<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">st</SUP> day after the date of such Casualty and ending on the 365<SUP

<U>however</U>, that such date shall be postponed by one day for each day that Licensor is actually delayed in substantially completing the Casualty Restoration Work by (i)&nbsp;any acts or omissions of the Rangers, the League or their respective
agents, employees or contractors or (ii)&nbsp;any one or more events of Force Majeure (provided that the maximum period such Casualty Outside Date shall be postponed due to events of Force Majeure is an additional 180 days). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(y)&#8195;If the Estimate with respect to the Casualty Restoration Work required as a result of such Casualty provides for an Estimated Date
that will occur during the period commencing on the 366<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP> day after the date of such Casualty and ending on the 540<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP> day after the date of
such Casualty, then the &#8220;<I>Casualty Outside Date</I>&#8221; applicable to such Casualty shall be the date that is 90 days following such Estimated Date; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that such date shall be postponed by one day for each
day that Licensor is actually delayed in substantially completing the Casualty Restoration Work by (i)&nbsp;any acts or omissions of the Rangers, the League or their respective agents, employees or contractors or (ii)&nbsp;any one or more events of
Force Majeure (provided that the maximum period such Casualty Outside Date shall be postponed due to events of Force Majeure is an additional 240 days). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(z)&#8195;If the Estimate with respect to the Casualty Restoration Work required as a result of such Casualty provides for an
Estimated Date that will occur on or after the 541<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">st</SUP> day following the date of such Casualty, then the &#8220;<I>Casualty Outside Date</I>&#8221; applicable to such Casualty shall be the date that
is 90 days following such Estimated Date; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that such date shall be postponed by one day for each day that Licensor is actually delayed in substantially completing the Casualty Restoration Work by (i)&nbsp;any acts or
omissions of the Rangers, the League or their respective agents, employees or contractors or (ii)&nbsp;any one or more events of Force Majeure (provided that the maximum period such Casualty Outside Date shall be postponed due to events of Force
Majeure is an additional 365 days). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;12.03</B>&#8195;<B><U>Condemnation Proceeding and Awards</U></B>. Upon
commencement of any Condemnation action or proceeding, Licensor and the Rangers shall cooperate with each other, and provide each other with such information and assistance, as each shall reasonably request in connection therewith. Licensor and the
Rangers each shall have the right, at its own expense, to appear and to participate in any and all hearings, trials and appeals relating thereto even if this Agreement has been terminated. Subject to the other provisions of this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;12.03</U>, in any Condemnation (x)&nbsp;the Rangers shall have the right to assert a claim against the condemning authority for, and receive from the condemning authority, all Condemnation Awards for, (i)&nbsp;any
damage to the Rangers&#8217; business or any loss in value of any of the rights granted to the Rangers under this Agreement (if applicable, as if this Agreement had not been terminated), (ii) the value of any of the Rangers&#8217; personal property
(tangible or intangible) taken or damaged as result of the Condemnation, (iii)&nbsp;any relocation costs of the Rangers&#8217; business, and (iv)&nbsp;any other damages to </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">45 </P>

</DIV></Center>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
which the Rangers may be entitled under any applicable law, ordinance, order or regulation, and (y)&nbsp;Licensor shall have the right to assert a claim against the condemning authority for, and
receive from the condemning authority, all Condemnation Awards for, (i)&nbsp;the loss in value of its ownership of and rights in and to the Arena and its other property (tangible and intangible), (ii) any damage to, or relocation costs of,
Licensor&#8217;s business, and (iii)&nbsp;any other damages to which Licensor may be entitled under any applicable law, ordinance, order or regulation. The Parties shall request that all Condemnation Awards be specifically allocated by the
applicable condemning authority (it being agreed that Licensor may direct that any such awards allocated to Licensor be paid to any Superior Interest Holder designated by Licensor for such purpose). If any Condemnation Award is not specifically
allocated between the Parties by the applicable condemning authority, the Condemnation Award shall be equitably allocated and distributed to Licensor and the Rangers in such manner as the Parties shall mutually agree. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;12.04</B>&#8195;<B><U>Temporary Taking</U></B>. If the whole or any part of the Arena or the right of Licensor
to occupy or possess the whole or any part of the Arena shall be taken in any Condemnation for a temporary use or occupancy not to exceed an aggregate of 24 months, or in the case of any such Condemnation that occurs during the last five
(5)&nbsp;Contract Years of the Term, one (1)&nbsp;year (a &#8220;<B>Temporary Taking</B>&#8221;), the Term shall not be reduced, extended or affected in any way, and neither Licensor nor the Rangers shall be relieved of its obligations under this
Agreement, except that (a)&nbsp;the Rangers shall have the right to make a claim against the condemning authority for, and receive from the condemning authority and retain, an award of any damages sustained by the Rangers as a result of such
Temporary Taking, and (b)&nbsp;the Rangers&#8217; obligation to pay the License Fee shall be abated during periods that the Arena is unavailable to the Rangers for the playing of Home Games in accordance with the terms and conditions of this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;12.05</B>&#8195;<B><U>Inability to Timely Restore; Estimate of Time and Cost to Restore</U></B>.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The determination of the estimated time and costs that are reasonably expected to be necessary to perform and substantially
complete any Condemnation Restoration Work or any Casualty Restoration Work shall be made by an independent architect or construction manager that is experienced in arena construction projects, well-regarded in the industry and selected by Licensor
and reasonably approved by the Rangers. In the event of any Condemnation or Casualty resulting in an Untenantable Condition, Licensor shall furnish to the Rangers an estimate (the &#8220;<B>Estimate</B>&#8221;), prepared and certified by such
independent architect or construction manager (the &#8220;<B>Estimator</B>&#8221;) of (i)&nbsp;the estimated date (the &#8220;<B>Estimated Date</B>&#8221;) by which the Condemnation Restoration Work or Casualty Restoration Work, as the case may be,
will be substantially completed and (ii)&nbsp;the estimated cost (the &#8220;<B>Estimated Restoration Cost</B>&#8221;) to perform the Condemnation Restoration Work or Casualty Restoration Work, as the case may be. Licensor shall use commercially
reasonable efforts to cause such independent architect or construction manager to make its determination as soon as reasonably practicable (and, in the case of a Casualty, no later than sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the date of such Casualty) and will
deliver the Estimate to the Rangers promptly upon Licensor&#8217;s receipt thereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;(i) If, during the performance of the
Condemnation Restoration Work or the Casualty Restoration Work required as a result of any Condemnation or Casualty, the Rangers </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">46 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
reasonably believe that the substantial completion of such Condemnation Restoration Work or such Casualty Restoration Work, as the case may be, will not, absent extraordinary efforts that
Licensor does not agree (if not already obligated to take pursuant to this Agreement), be achieved by the applicable Condemnation Outside Date or applicable Casualty Outside Date therefor (as such Condemnation Outside Date or such Casualty Outside
Date may have theretofore been postponed pursuant to the provisions of Section&nbsp;12.01(d) or Section&nbsp;12.02(d) above, respectively), then the Rangers, by notice given to Licensor and the Estimator, shall have the right (not to be exercised
more than once in any six (6)&nbsp;month period) with respect to such Condemnation or such Casualty to request that the Estimator determine the estimated date (the &#8220;<B>Revised Estimated Date</B>&#8221;) by which such Condemnation Restoration
Work or such Casualty Restoration Work, as the case may be, is then reasonably expected to be substantially completed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii)&#8195;If the
Rangers give such notice pursuant to Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(i) above, then Licensor, within ten (10)&nbsp;business days after its receipt of such notice, shall have the right to submit to the Rangers and to the Estimator a notice that (x)&nbsp;sets
forth any information that Licensor reasonably believes is relevant to the determination of the Revised Estimated Date and/or (y)&nbsp;indicates the measures that Licensor intends and agrees to implement in an effort to cause the substantial
completion of such Condemnation Restoration Work or such Casualty Restoration Work, as the case may be, to be achieved by the applicable Condemnation Outside Date or the applicable Casualty Outside Date (as such Condemnation Outside Date or such
Casualty Outside Date may have theretofore been postponed pursuant to the provisions of Section&nbsp;12.01(d) or Section&nbsp;12.02(d) above, respectively). Within ten (10)&nbsp;business days after the Rangers&#8217; receipt of Licensor&#8217;s
notice (or, if Licensor does not give such notice, within twenty (20)&nbsp;business days after Licensor&#8217;s receipt of the Rangers notice given pursuant to Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(i) above), the Rangers shall have the right to submit to Licensor
and the Estimator a notice that sets forth any information that the Rangers reasonably believes is relevant to the determination of the Revised Estimated Date. In determining the Revised Estimated Date, the Estimator shall take into consideration
all information and measures set forth in any notices provided by the Parties pursuant to the two immediately preceding sentences, as well as all other relevant factors. Licensor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to cause the Estimator to
make its determination of the Revised Estimated Date as soon as reasonably practicable after receipt of the Rangers&#8217; notice given pursuant to Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(i) above and the notices which each Party is entitled to deliver pursuant to
this Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(ii), and Licensor shall deliver such determination of the Revised Estimated Date to the Rangers promptly upon Licensor&#8217;s receipt thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii)&#8195;Each Party shall have the option (the &#8220;<B>Review Option</B>&#8221;), exercised by notice given to the other within ten
(10)&nbsp;business days after Licensor delivers to the Rangers the Estimator&#8217;s determination of the Revised Estimated Date, to require that the Estimator&#8217;s determination of the Revised Estimated Date be reviewed by another independent
architect or construction manager that is experienced in arena construction projects, well-regarded in the industry and mutually selected by the Parties (the &#8220;<B>Second Estimator</B>&#8221;). If the Parties are unable to mutually select the
Second Estimator within ten (10)&nbsp;business days after the giving of a notice exercising the Review Option, then either Licensor or the Rangers, by giving ten (10)&nbsp;days&#8217; notice to the other, shall have the right to request that the
presiding judge of the lowest level court of general jurisdiction for the district in which the Arena is located select the Second Estimator. Licensor shall use commercially </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">47 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
reasonable efforts to cause the Second Estimator, as soon as reasonably practicable after the selection thereof, to (x)&nbsp;review the Estimator&#8217;s determination of the Revised Estimated
Date, (y)&nbsp;make its own determination of the Revised Estimated Date (which determination shall be made in accordance with the provisions of Section&nbsp;12.05 (b)(ii) above) and (z)&nbsp;deliver to Licensor written notice indicating whether the
Second Estimator agrees with the determination of the Estimator and, if not, setting forth the Second Estimator&#8217;s determination of the Revised Estimated Date. For all purposes of this Agreement, the &#8220;<B>Final Revised Estimated
Date</B>&#8221; shall mean either (a)&nbsp;the Revised Estimated Date determined by the Estimator, if neither Party timely exercises the Review Option or if a Party exercises the Review Option and the Second Estimator agrees with the
Estimator&#8217;s determination of the Revised Estimated Date; or (b)&nbsp;the Revised Estimated Date determined by the Second Estimator, if a Party exercises the Review Option and the Second Estimator disagrees with the Estimator&#8217;s
determination of the Revised Estimated Date and therefore issues its own determination of the Revised Estimated Date. Licensor shall deliver the Second Estimator&#8217;s written notice to the Rangers promptly upon Licensor&#8217;s receipt thereof.
The fees and expenses of the Estimator and the Second Estimator for the exercise set forth in this Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(iii) and in Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(ii) above shall be borne equally by Licensor and the Rangers. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv)&#8195;If the Final Revised Estimated Date with respect to any Condemnation or Casualty is later than the date that is 365 days after the
applicable Condemnation Outside Date or applicable Casualty Outside Date therefor (each of which, for purposes of this paragraph (iv), shall be deemed to be such applicable Condemnation Outside Date or such applicable Casualty Outside as postponed
by the maximum number of days by which same may be postponed due to events of Force Majeure pursuant to Section&nbsp;12.01(d) or Section&nbsp;12.02(d) above, respectively), then the Rangers shall have the right to terminate this Agreement without
any further liability hereunder, except for any liability hereunder which, by the specific terms of this Agreement survives termination. If the Rangers wish to exercise such right of termination, then it shall do so by notice to Licensor given not
later than the date that is sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the date on which the Final Revised Estimated Date is determined (it being agreed that the Final Revised Estimated Date shall be deemed determined either as of the date on which the
Parties&#8217; right to exercise the Review Option shall have lapsed or, if a Party timely exercises the Review Option, as of the date on which the Second Estimator&#8217;s notice of determination is given to the Rangers). If the Rangers terminate
this Agreement as provided in this Section&nbsp;12.05(b)(iv), then such termination shall be effective on the date specified in the Knick&#8217;s notice of termination, but no earlier than thirty (30)&nbsp;days after the date of such notice and no
later than one hundred eighty (180)&nbsp;days after the date of such notice, as if said date were the date fixed for the expiration of the Term. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;12.06</B>&#8195;<B><U>Replacement Arena</U></B><B><U>; Rent Abatement</U></B>. In the event of the occurrence of
a Condemnation or Casualty that results in an Untenantable Condition but does not result in termination of this Agreement, the Rangers, during the continuance of such Untenantable Condition, shall have the right to use an alternate site for Rangers
Events while the Arena is being restored, provided such use fully complies with the requirements of Paragraph 6 of the Property Tax Exemption Agreement, and the Rangers&#8217; obligation to pay the License Fee shall be abated during such periods in
accordance with Section&nbsp;20.01. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;12.07</B>&#8195;<B><U>Intention of the
Parties</U></B><B><U></U></B><B>. </B>The provisions of this Article XII shall be deemed an express agreement governing any case of the Arena or any portion thereof becoming untenantable or unfit for occupancy, and Section&nbsp;227 of the Real
Property Law of the State of New York, providing for such contingency in the absence of an express agreement, and any other legal requirements of like import, now or hereafter in force, shall have no application in such case and are expressly waived
by the Parties. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XIII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>INDEMNIFICATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;13.01&#8195; <U>General Indemnification</U></B>.<B></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;To the extent permitted by applicable law, Licensor and the Rangers shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other and its
current and future Affiliates, and each of their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns from and against any and all claims, liability, loss, damages (whether actual, incidental, consequential, punitive or
otherwise), judgments, settlement expenses, cost and expenses whatsoever, including court costs, reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees and related disbursements, with regard to any action, cause of action or claim of any nature (each, a
&#8220;<B>Loss</B>&#8221;), in any way arising out of or related to (i)&nbsp;the indemnifying Party&#8217;s acts or omissions in or about the Arena (except to the extent solely caused by the indemnified Party&#8217;s negligence or misconduct); (ii)
the indemnifying Party&#8217;s failure to fulfill any duty or obligation hereunder or to comply with applicable law or the obligations applicable to the indemnifying Party in the ADA Consent Decree; or (iii)&nbsp;the indemnifying Party&#8217;s
breach of any representations, warranties or covenants contained in this Agreement. Each Party&#8217;s indemnity hereunder shall include the acts and omissions of its contractors, licensees, agents and employees. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Without limiting the provisions of Subparagraph 13.01(a), Licensor and the Rangers indemnify the other party for any damage to the
property (whether in or about the Arena) of the other party caused by the acts or omissions of the indemnifying party&#8217;s contractors, licensees, agents, employees and invitees, limited however (for purposes of clarity), in the case of the
Rangers, to Rangers Misuse. All repairs to the damaged property of Licensor shall be made by firm(s) designated by Licensor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;While the Parties are Affiliates, Sections 13.01(a) and 13.01(b) shall not restrict the Parties&#8217; access to the League&#8217;s
leaguewide insurance policies, to the extent they would otherwise be covered by the terms of such policies. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;13.02&#8195;
<U>Notice of Claims and Rights to Defend and Settle Claims</U></B>. The indemnified Party agrees to serve the indemnifying Party with prompt written notice of any claims which could give rise to the indemnifying Party&#8217;s indemnity hereunder,
and the indemnifying Party and its insurance carrier(s) shall have the right to defend such claims with counsel of their choosing. The indemnified Party shall not settle any claim without the indemnifying Party&#8217;s (or its insurer&#8217;s) prior
written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">49 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XIV </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">INSURANCE AND SUBROGATION </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.01&#8195; <U>Rangers Insurance</U><U> Coverage</U></B>. The Rangers shall, from and after the Commencement Date, maintain
at its expense in force the following insurance: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Property insurance for the full one hundred percent (100%) of replacement cost
of all of the Rangers&#8217; equipment, improvements, and betterments owned by the Rangers, literary or musical material, and all other properties and materials owned, rented or brought onto the premises by the Rangers. Coverage shall be on an All
Risk of physical loss or damage basis; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Commercial general liability insurance covering against bodily injury and property
damage having a limit of not less than $1,000,000 for each occurrence and a limit of not less than $5,000,000 in the aggregate for each occurrence. Coverages shall be in accordance with the ISO form or equivalent. Such insurance shall include, but
not be limited to, contractual liability, premises operations, products, completed operations, personal injury, advertising injury, bodily injury and property damage; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Liquor liability insurance coverage having limits of not less than $1,000,000 for each common cause and in the aggregate; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Automobile liability insurance coverage for bodily injury and property damage with a combined single limit of no less than
$1,000,000; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Employer&#8217;s liability insurance with the following minimum limits: bodily injury by accident - $1,000,000 each
accident; bodily injury by disease - $1,000,000 policy limit and $1,000,000 each employee; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;Umbrella or excess liability
coverage, following the terms, conditions, and extensions of coverages, to apply over and above the primary coverages in subsections (b), (c), (d), and (e), in an amount not less than $200,000,000 in the aggregate; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g)&#8195;Statutory worker&#8217;s compensation coverage; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h)&#8195;Employment practices liability insurance with minimum limits of $10,000,000 per claim; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)&#8195;Media liability policy with limits of no less than $5,000,000 per claim/$5,000,000 aggregate; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j)&#8195;Disability insurance as required by the State of New York. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The insurance referred to in this Section&nbsp;14.01, with the exception of property insurance, employment practices liability insurance, worker&#8217;s
compensation and employer&#8217;s liability coverage, shall name Licensor and its Affiliates and mortgagees, and each of their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns, as additional insureds for claims
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">50 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
arising in connection with Rangers&#8217; operations. Licensor shall also have the right to require the Rangers, from time to time, to increase the scope and limits of any insurance coverage
required to be carried herein, so long as such increase is commercially reasonable under the circumstances. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.02&#8195;
<U>Rangers Insurance Requirements</U>. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The Rangers shall, at its own expense, obtain and maintain during the Term and if
written on a claims made basis for three (3)&nbsp;years thereafter, policies of insurance as required herein written by an insurance carrier(s) reasonably acceptable to Licensor that is authorized to do business in the State of New York, rated <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">A-VII</FONT> or better in the most current edition of A.M. Best&#8217;s Insurance Report (or if such report shall cease to be published, such comparable rating system as reasonably determined by Licensor), and with
deductible and self-insurance retention amounts that are not in excess of amounts which are commercially reasonable under the circumstances (except that in the event that any maximum deductible or self-insurance retention amounts are mandated either
by law, such mandated maximum amounts shall not be exceeded regardless of whether higher amounts may be commercially reasonable under the circumstances). All liability insurance policies must provide Cross Liability coverage (separation of insureds
or severability of interest provisions). Further, coverage for the additional insureds shall apply on a primary and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-contributory</FONT> basis irrespective of any other insurance maintained by the additional
insureds, whether collectible or not, for claims arising in connection with the Rangers&#8217; operations. Policies written on a claims made basis shall be maintained for a period of at least three (3)&nbsp;years after termination of the Term. The
insurance requirements set forth will in no way modify, reduce, or limit the indemnification herein made by the Rangers. Receipt of a certificate of insurance, endorsement or policy of insurance which is more restrictive than the contracted for
insurance shall not be construed as a waiver or modification of the insurance requirements above or an implied agreement to modify same, nor is any verbal agreement to modify same permissible or binding. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;In the event of cancellation of any policies with respect to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-payment</FONT> of any premium or
premiums, the Rangers shall provide at least ten (10)&nbsp;days advance written notice of same to the Licensor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;In the event
that Licensor is in receipt of such notice of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-payment</FONT> and/or cancellation, Licensor shall have the right, but not the obligation, to pay for any commercially reasonable costs and expenses which shall be
required to maintain or reinstate such insurance, and to charge the Rangers for any and all expenses incurred in connection therewith. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.03&#8195; <U>Rangers Certificates of Insurance</U>.</B> The Rangers shall provide Licensor with appropriate evidence of
insurance setting forth the required coverages not later than ten (10)&nbsp;days prior to the date on which such coverage is required to be obtained hereunder. For each consecutive year, the Rangers shall provide appropriate evidence of insurance no
later than ten (10)&nbsp;days before the policies are required to be renewed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.04&#8195; <U>Rangers Waiver of
Subrogation</U>.</B> The Rangers shall include in each of their policies insuring against (a)&nbsp;loss, damage or destruction by fire or any other peril covering any property owned, borrowed, or in the Rangers&#8217; care, custody, or control, or
(b)&nbsp;injuries to any </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">51 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
employee or agent of the Rangers, a waiver of the insurance carriers&#8217; rights of subrogation against Licensor. If such waiver is unobtainable from any of the Rangers&#8217; insurance
carriers, the Rangers shall obtain (i)&nbsp;an express agreement that such policy shall not be invalidated if the Rangers waive or had waived the right of recovery against Licensor, or (ii)&nbsp;any other form of permission of release of Licensor.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;14.05</B>&#8195; <B><U>Licensor Insurance Coverage</U></B>. Licensor shall, from and after the Commencement
Date, maintain at its expense in force the following minimum insurance: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;<B> </B>Property insurance for the replacement cost of
the Arena, including all equipment, improvements and betterments owned by Licensor. Coverage shall be on an All Risk of physical loss or damage basis, including losses arising out of a terrorism event; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Employer&#8217;s liability insurance with the following minimum limits: bodily injury by accident - $1,000,000 each accident; bodily
injury by disease - $1,000,000 policy limit and $1,000,000 each employee; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Statutory worker&#8217;s compensation coverage; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Disability insurance as required by the State of New York; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Commercial general liability insurance covering against bodily injury and property damage having a limit of not less than $1,000,000
for each occurrence and a limit of not less than $5,000,000 in the aggregate for each occurrence. Coverages shall be in accordance with the ISO form or equivalent. Such insurance shall include, but not be limited to, contractual liability, premises
operations, products, completed operations, personal injury, advertising injury, bodily injury and property damage; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;Liquor
liability insurance coverage having limits of not less than $1,000,000 for each common cause and in the aggregate; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g)&#8195;Automobile
liability insurance coverage for bodily injury and property damage with a combined single limit of no less than $1,000,000; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h)&#8195;Umbrella or excess liability coverage, following the terms, conditions, and extensions of coverages, to apply over the
employer&#8217;s liability coverage in subsection (b)&nbsp;and above the primary coverages (e), (f) and (g), in an amount not less than $200,000,000 in the aggregate; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)&#8195;Employment practices liability insurance with minimum limits of $10,000,000; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j)&#8195;Media liability policy with limits of no less than $5,000,000 per claim/$5,000,000 aggregate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The liability insurance referred to in this Section&nbsp;14.05, in paragraphs (e)&nbsp;and (h), shall include the Rangers and its Affiliates, and each of their
respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns, as additional insureds for claims arising in connection with Licensor&#8217;s </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">52 </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.06&#8195;<U>Licensor Insurance Requirements</U>.</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Licensor shall, at its own expense, obtain and maintain during the Term and if written on a claims made basis for three

edition of A.M. Best&#8217;s Insurance Report (or if such report shall cease to be published, such comparable rating system as reasonably determined by the Rangers), and with deductible and self-insurance retention amounts that are not in excess of

whether higher amounts may be commercially reasonable under the circumstances). All liability insurance policies must provide Cross Liability coverage (separation of insureds or severability of interest provisions). Policies written on a claims made
basis shall be maintained for a period of three (3)&nbsp;years after termination of the Term. The insurance requirements set forth will in no way modify, reduce, or limit the indemnification herein made by Licensor. Receipt of a certificate of
insurance, endorsement or policy of insurance which is more restrictive than the contracted for insurance shall not be construed as a waiver or modification of the insurance requirements above or an implied agreement to modify same, nor is any
verbal agreement to modify same permissible or binding. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;In the event of cancellation of any policies with respect to <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-payment</FONT> of any premium or premiums, Licensor shall provide at least ten (10)&nbsp;days advance written notice of same to the Rangers. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;In the event that the Rangers are in receipt of such notice of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-payment</FONT> and/or
cancellation, the Rangers shall have the right, but not the obligation, to pay for any commercially reasonable costs and expenses which shall be required to maintain or reinstate such insurance, and to charge Licensor for any and all expenses
incurred in connection therewith. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.07&#8195; <U>Licensor Certificates of Insurance</U>.</B> Licensor shall provide the
Rangers with appropriate evidence of insurance setting forth the required coverages not later than ten (10)&nbsp;days prior to the date on which such coverage is required to be obtained hereunder. For each consecutive year, Licensor shall provide
appropriate evidence of insurance no later than ten (10)&nbsp;days before the policies are required to be renewed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;14.08&#8195; <U>Licensor Waiver of Subrogation</U></B>. Licensor shall include in each of its policies insuring against
(a)&nbsp;loss, damage or destruction by fire or any other peril covering any owned property or (b)&nbsp;injuries to any employee or agent of Licensor, a waiver of the insurance carriers&#8217; rights of subrogation against the Rangers. If such
waiver is unobtainable from any of </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">53 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
Licensor&#8217;s insurance carriers, Licensor shall obtain (i)&nbsp;an express agreement that such policy shall not be invalidated if Licensor waives or had waived the right of recovery against
the Rangers, or (ii)&nbsp;any other form of permission of release of the Rangers. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XV </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>WORK STOPPAGE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;15.01&#8195; <U>Impact on License Fee</U>.</B> If, during any NHL season, any previously scheduled Home Game is cancelled as a
result of a strike, work stoppage, lockout, or other suspension or cancellation of NHL play arising out of a labor dispute involving NHL players or referees, or any other League-related labor or other dispute (each a &#8220;<B>Work
Stoppage</B>&#8221;), there shall be no reduction in the License Fee; provided, however, that, upon any such cancellation, Licensor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to hold the Arena out for relicense on such Home Date, and in the event
that Licensor relicenses the Arena on such Home Date during the time of the previously scheduled Home Game, Licensor will refund to the Rangers the lesser of (i)&nbsp;fifty percent (50%) of any net contribution attributable to the relicense of the
Arena and (ii)&nbsp;the pro rata portion of the annual License Fee attributable to such Home Date (i.e. 1/44<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP> of the License Fee if there had been 41 home games and 3 preseason games scheduled)
(the &#8220;<B>Work Stoppage Abatement</B>&#8221;). If, during any season in which the Rangers receive a Work Stoppage Abatement, any previously scheduled Home Games are cancelled as a result of a Work Stoppage and subsequently rescheduled, any Work
Stoppage Abatement received by the Rangers shall be reduced by an amount equal to the Work Stoppage Abatement, divided by the number of Home Games that were cancelled and multiplied by the number of Home Games that were subsequently rescheduled.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;15.02&#8195;<U>Treatment of Refunds or Credits</U>.</B> Any refunds or credits granted to Licensor&#8217;s suite or other
licensees, sponsors, advertisers or other third parties (including any concessionaire or service provider) that relates to the Work Stoppage shall be determined in Licensor&#8217;s reasonable discretion, but may not exceed the Team&#8217;s allocable
share of such revenue for a full-season work stoppage (pro rata for a partial-season work stoppage) (&#8220;<B>Maximum Credit or Refund</B>&#8221;<B>)</B>. Licensor shall retain 25% of the difference, if any, between the Maximum Credit or Refund and
the actual credit or refund attributable to such assets. Any refunds or credits shall be deducted from the Rangers&#8217; share of revenue under this Agreement for the applicable Arena assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;15.03&#8195;<U>Scheduling</U>.</B> Upon the occurrence of a Work Stoppage, Licensor may schedule events on previously
scheduled Home Dates during the period for which the League has cancelled games. If a Work Stoppage results in the partial cancellation of a season, the Parties shall mutually agree in good faith on the rescheduling of Home Games. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">54 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XVI </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTAIN TAXES </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;16.01&#8195; <U>Property Taxes</U>. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;The Rangers shall be responsible for the payment, without demand, counter-claim or offset, of fifty percent (50%) (the
&#8220;<B>Rangers&#8217; Tax Share</B>&#8221;) of any real property or similar taxes applicable to the Arena (&#8220;<B>Arena Property Tax</B>&#8221;).&nbsp;Licensor may notify any jurisdiction imposing (or proposing to impose) any Arena Property
Tax that the Rangers have full responsibility for the payment of 50% of any such Arena Property Tax and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, rule or regulation, Licensor shall arrange for such Arena Property Tax to be billed directly to the
Rangers.&nbsp;Licensor shall promptly provide to the Rangers copies of all materials relating to any Arena Property Tax that it receives from any government authority. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) &#8195;Licensor and the Rangers acknowledge that, as of the Commencement Date, Licensor is exempt, pursuant to the laws of the State of
New York and that certain agreement between the Mayor of the City of New York, acting as Chief Executive Officer of, and for, the City of New York, and Licensor&#8217;s and the Rangers&#8217; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">predecessor-in-interest</FONT></FONT> Madison Square Garden Center, Inc., dated July&nbsp;15, 1982 (the &#8220;<B>Property Tax Exemption Agreement</B>&#8221;), from paying any Arena Property Tax in connection with the
Arena (the &#8220;<B>Property Tax Exemption</B>&#8221;). Licensor and the Rangers shall each use all commercially reasonable efforts to cause the Property Tax Exemption to remain in effect at all times during the term of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;16.02&#8195; <U>Commercial Rent Tax</U>.</B> The Rangers shall be responsible for paying directly, and shall timely pay, to
the City of New York the &#8220;Commercial Rent Or Occupancy Tax&#8221; imposed pursuant to Chapter 7 of Title 11 of the New York City Administrative Code, or successor or similar tax assessed or imposed on a tenant as a consequence of the
Rangers&#8217; status as a licensee under this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XVII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>RANGERS DEFAULT; LICENSOR&#8217;S RIGHTS AND REMEDIES </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;17.01&#8195;<U>Rangers Default</U>.</B> The occurrence of any one or more of the following events shall constitute a default
by the Rangers under this Agreement (each, a &#8220;<B>Rangers Default</B>&#8221;): </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Failure by the Rangers to timely pay any
amount owed by the Rangers to Licensor pursuant to this Agreement if such failure shall continue for fourteen (14)&nbsp;days after notice thereof is received by the Rangers from Licensor; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Failure by the Rangers to maintain the Team&#8217;s membership in the NHL; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;The levy upon or other execution or the attachment by legal process of the interest of the Rangers in the Arena herein, or the
filing or creation of a lien in respect of such interest, which levy, attachment or lien shall not be released, discharged or bonded against within sixty (60)&nbsp;days from the date of such filing; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;The making by the Rangers of an assignment for the benefit of creditors; an adjudication that the Rangers are bankrupt, insolvent or
unable to pay its debts as they mature; the filing by or against the Rangers of a petition to have the Rangers adjudged bankrupt, or a petition </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">55 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
for reorganization or arrangement under any law relating to bankruptcy unless, in the case of a petition filed against the Rangers, the case is dismissed within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the
filing thereof; the appointment of a trustee or receiver to take possession of substantially all of the Rangers&#8217; assets or the Rangers&#8217; interests in this Agreement unless the appointment is revoked within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the
appointment thereof; or an attachment, execution or levy against substantially all of the Rangers&#8217; interests in this Agreement unless the attachment, execution or levy is revoked within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the attachment, execution or
levy; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Breach by the Rangers of ARTICLE XI (an &#8220;<B>Exclusivity Breach</B>&#8221;); and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f)&#8195;Failure by the Rangers to observe or perform in any material respect any covenant, agreement, condition, or provision of this
Agreement not otherwise specified in this ARTICLE XVII if such failure shall continue for sixty (60)<B></B>&nbsp;days after notice thereof from Licensor to the Rangers; provided that the Rangers shall not be in a Rangers Default with respect to
matters that cannot reasonably be cured within sixty (60)<B></B>&nbsp;days so long as within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after such notice the Rangers commence such cure and diligently and continuously proceed to complete the same, but in any event, the
Rangers shall not have more than ninety (90)&nbsp;days from its receipt of such notice to cure such failure. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;17.02&#8195;
<U>Remedies of Licensor</U>.</B> If a Rangers Default occurs, Licensor shall have the following rights and remedies which shall be distinct, separate, and, to the extent not mutually exclusive, cumulative: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;In addition to any other legal or equitable damages as may be available to Licensor and subject to clause (b)&nbsp;below, Licensor
may enforce this Agreement by seeking specific performance of any Rangers covenant or agreement contained herein or the enforcement of any other appropriate legal or equitable remedy, including self-help (following notice, expiration of any
applicable cure period, and failure to cure) and recoupment from the Rangers of the reasonable cost of curing any default on the Rangers&#8217; behalf (and the right to offset such cost from any amounts due from Licensor pursuant to this Agreement);
and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, Licensor shall not, under any circumstances, have the right to
terminate this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;17.03&#8195; <U>Remedies of Licensor for </U><U>an Exclusivity Breach</U>.</B> The Rangers
hereby acknowledge that Licensor and its Affiliates will be irreparably and continually harmed by any Exclusivity Breach or the threat thereof and that damages for an Exclusivity Breach cannot be estimated with any degree of certainty and that
monetary damages cannot fairly or adequately compensate Licensor for an Exclusivity Breach. The Rangers further acknowledge that Licensor does not have an adequate remedy at law for an Exclusivity Breach. Accordingly, the Rangers hereby acknowledge
that, in the event of an Exclusivity Breach, Licensor shall, in addition to any other applicable available rights and remedies, be entitled to seek and obtain, and the Rangers hereby consent to the entry of, a temporary restraining order, together
with temporary, preliminary and permanent injunctive or other equitable relief, from any court of competent jurisdiction to enjoin any violation or threatened violation of ARTICLE XI and to compel the Rangers to comply </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">56 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
with or restrain or cease from breaching or violating the covenants of ARTICLE XI. The Rangers hereby waive any requirement that Licensor post a bond or other security in connection with
injunctive or other equitable relief. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;17.04&#8195; <U>League&#8217;s Right to Notice of and Cure Rangers
Defaults</U>.</B> Licensor shall simultaneously serve the League, at the addresses set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;20.04</U>, with copies of all notices of Rangers Defaults served upon the Rangers. Licensor shall accept a cure of a
Rangers Default by the League within the applicable cure period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XVIII </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>LICENSOR DEFAULT; RANGERS&#8217; RIGHTS AND REMEDIES; RIGHTS IN THE EVENT OF REPEAL OF PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;18.01&#8195; <U>Licensor Default</U>.</B> The occurrence of any one or more of the following shall constitute a default by
Licensor under this Agreement (each, a &#8220;<B>Licensor Default</B>&#8221;): </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;Failure by Licensor to timely pay any amount
owed by Licensor to the Rangers pursuant to this Agreement if such failure shall continue for fourteen (14)&nbsp;days after notice thereof is received by Licensor; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;The making by Licensor of an assignment for the benefit of creditors; an adjudication that Licensor is bankrupt, insolvent or unable
to pay its debts as they mature; the filing by or against Licensor of a petition to have Licensor adjudged bankrupt, or a petition for reorganization or arrangement under any law relating to bankruptcy unless, in the case of a petition filed against
the Licensor, the case is dismissed within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after the filing thereof; the appointment of a trustee or receiver to take possession of substantially all of Licensor&#8217;s assets or Licensor&#8217;s interests in this Agreement; or
an attachment, execution or levy against substantially all of Licensor&#8217;s interests in this Agreement; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Failure by Licensor
to provide the Rangers with any of the Rangers&#8217; rights hereunder that interferes with the playing of Home Games in the Arena; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;Failure by Licensor to cause the Arena to be maintained and operated in accordance with, or otherwise to meet and observe, the
Standard, and such failure shall continue for fifteen (15)&nbsp;days after notice thereof from the Rangers to Licensor; provided that if such failure cannot reasonably be cured within such fifteen (15)&nbsp;days, then Licensor shall have up to an
additional fifteen (15)&nbsp;days to cure such failure as long as, within fifteen (15)&nbsp;days after such notice, it diligently undertakes and pursues such cure and provides the Rangers with reasonable evidence that it is diligently undertaking
and pursuing such cure, but in any event, Licensor shall not have more thirty (30)&nbsp;days from its receipt of notice of such failure from the Rangers to cure such failure; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)&#8195;Failure by Licensor to observe or perform in any material respect any covenant, agreement, condition, or provision of this Agreement
not otherwise specified in this ARTICLE XVIII </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">57 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
if such failure shall continue for sixty (60)&nbsp;days after notice thereof from the Rangers to Licensor; provided that Licensor shall not be in a Licensor Default with respect to matters that
cannot reasonably be cured within sixty (60)&nbsp;days so long as within sixty (60)&nbsp;days after such notice Licensor commences such cure and diligently and continuously proceeds to complete the same, but in any event, Licensor shall not have
more than ninety (90)&nbsp;days from its receipt of such notice to cure such failure. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;18.02&#8195;<U>Remedies of
</U><U>the Rangers</U>.</B> If a Licensor Default occurs, the Rangers shall have the following rights and remedies, which shall be distinct, separate, and, to the extent not mutually exclusive, cumulative: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;In addition to any other legal or equitable remedies as may be available to the Rangers and subject to clause (b)&nbsp;below, the
Rangers may enforce the provisions of this Agreement and may enforce and protect the rights of the Rangers herein by seeking specific performance of any covenant or agreement contained herein, or the enforcement of any other appropriate legal or
equitable remedy, including self-help (following notice, expiration of applicable cure period, and failure to cure) and recoupment from Licensor of the reasonable cost of curing any default on Licensor&#8217;s behalf (and the right to offset such
cost, or any amounts due from Licensor pursuant to this Agreement, against any amount then owed by the Rangers to Licensor pursuant to this Agreement), and recovery of all monies due or to become due from Licensor under any provisions of this
Agreement; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, the Rangers shall not, under any circumstances, have the
right to terminate this Agreement, except as set forth in ARTICLE XII. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;18.03&#8195; <U>Rights in the Event of Repeal of
Property Tax Exemption</U>. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a)&#8195;In the event the Property Tax Exemption is no longer in effect <B>[*****]</B> (a &#8220;No Fault
Occurrence&#8221;), the Rangers shall remain responsible for fifty percent (50%) of the Arena Property Tax for the remainder of the Term, unless the Parties agree to extend this provision. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)&#8195;In the event the Property Tax Exemption is no longer in effect due to a breach of the Property Tax Exemption Agreement by the
Rangers that leads to the loss of the Property Tax Exemption, the Rangers shall be responsible for 100% of any Arena Property Tax for the remainder of the Term. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)&#8195;Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in Sections 16.01 or 18.03(a), in the event of a loss of the Property Tax Exemption
<B>[*****]</B>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)&#8195;<B>[*****]</B>. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">58 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XIX </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ASSIGNMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;19.01&#8195; <U>Licensor Assignment</U>.</B> Licensor shall have the right to assign this Agreement upon written notice to the
Rangers to any Person that acquires the Arena, provided the assignee agrees in writing to assume all of Licensor&#8217;s obligations under this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;19.02&#8195; <U>Rangers Assignment</U>.</B> The Rangers shall have the right to assign this Agreement upon written notice to
Licensor to any Person that acquires the Team in accordance with League Rules, provided the assignee agrees in writing to assume all of the Rangers&#8217; obligations under this Agreement. The Rangers shall further have the rights to collaterally
assign this Agreement to secure indebtedness of the Rangers incurred in accordance with League Rules. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;19.03&#8195; <U>No
Other Assignment</U>.</B> Except as set forth in this <U>ARTICLE XIX</U>, neither Party shall be permitted to assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. A
change in ownership of either Party shall not be deemed an assignment under this Section&nbsp;19. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ARTICLE XX </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>MISCELLANEOUS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;20.01&#8195; <U>Force Majeure</U>.</B> Should any fire or other casualty, act of God, earthquake, flood, epidemic, landslide,
enemy act, war, riot, act or threat of terrorism, civil commotion, general unavailability of certain materials; a strike, slowdown, boycott or labor dispute (other than a strike, slowdown, boycott or labor dispute involving the League), or any other
similar event beyond the reasonable control of the subject Party (each, a &#8220;<B>Force Majeure</B>&#8221;) prevent performance of this Agreement by such Party in accordance with its provisions, performance of this Agreement (other than the
payment of any sum of money owed hereunder, subject to the final two sentences of this Section&nbsp;20.01) by such Party shall be suspended or excused to the extent commensurate with such interfering occurrence. In the event of a Force Majeure, the
Rangers shall be permitted to schedule and play Home Games at an alternate location, provided that playing games in such location fully complies with the requirements of Paragraph 6 of the Property Tax Exemption Agreement. In the event of a Force
Majeure (including a governmental action) that results in (a)&nbsp;attendance at Arena events being limited to 1000 attendees or less per event for any period (a &#8220;Restricted Attendance Period&#8221;), the Rangers shall be permitted to schedule
and play Home Games at the Arena during the Restricted Attendance Period; the pro rata License Fee attributable to any Home Games played at the Arena during any Restricted Attendance Period shall be reduced by 80% or (b)&nbsp;attendance at Arena
events being materially limited (but greater than 1000 attendees), the parties will negotiate in good faith to agree on an appropriate reduction to the License Fee. Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Rangers&#8217; obligation to
pay the License Fee for periods for which the Arena is unavailable for Home Games due to a Force Majeure event (including a governmental action or the occurrence of any Untenantable Condition) shall be abated during such periods. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">59 </P>

</DIV></Center>

approvals permitted or required to be given by Licensor or the Rangers under this Agreement shall not be valid unless such consent or approval is in writing, signed by the Party by or on whose behalf such consent or approval is executed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Section&nbsp;20.03&#8195; <U>Entire Agreement</U>.</B> This Agreement, including the schedules and exhibits attached hereto, which are

under this Agreement shall be in writing, signed by the Party or an officer, agent, or attorney of the Party giving the notice and shall be deemed to be given upon receipt if delivered personally by nationally recognized overnight courier providing
